title: Mystery Shopper in Lithuania
description:
Mystery Shopper in Lithuania

Work tasks: WHAT OUR MYSTERY SHOPPERS DO
Mystery shoppers do not need to be customer service experts, as their personal opinion is not the deciding factor. However, they must be able to assess customer interactions and the service process objectively. We measure how closely employees’ customer service aligns with their company’s service standards and expectations, enabling businesses to identify development needs and provide targeted training. At the same time, we are confident that our mystery shoppers gradually become customer service professionals themselves. We believe this experience increases their value in the job market, especially in customer-facing roles, as we continuously train and guide our mystery shoppers. Our mystery shoppers are welcome to include “Trendline Mystery Shopper” on their CV. For many employers, this demonstrates a solid understanding of customer service processes. WHAT A TRENDLINE MYSTERY SHOPPER DOES NOT DO Trendline mystery shoppers do not provoke or deliberately challenge employees with difficult or misleading questions. Our mystery shoppers visit service providers, banks, retail stores, and sales organizations. The objective is for the mystery shopper to behave like an ordinary customer. This means they do not ask unusual questions that a typical customer would not ask and do not attempt to provoke employees in any way. Mystery shopping visits are conducted according to scenarios provided by Trendline. After each visit, the mystery shopper submits a detailed report through the Trendline online platform.

We offer: https://trendline.lt

    • Participation to the Bids and proposals.

• 5-8 years of experience in AI and data science algorithm development (preferable for satellite Remote Sensing or imagery/video data).

Technical Skills (Hard Skills)

• Experience with Deep Learning and/or simple Machine Learning techniques, attention- based architecture, foundation model (adapting, fine-tuning, evaluating and, where relevant, pre-training foundation models for Earth Observation data -Vision and Large Language models in particular);
• Proficiency in python with solid object-oriented programming practices and experience building modular, scalable pipelines;

title: Assistant Manager – Fund Accounting (m/f)
description:
Assistant Manager – Fund Accounting

Role Overview

Within the Fund Administration department, the Assistant Manager is responsible for overseeing a portfolio of complex and high‑profile fund structures, ensuring high‑quality service delivery, regulatory compliance, and timely reporting.

The role combines technical expertise, team leadership, and client ownership. The Assistant Manager acts as a key escalation point for both clients and internal teams and supports the Manager in driving operational excellence, risk management, and process improvement.

Tasks

Client & Delivery Ownership

• Act as the primary point of contact for a portfolio of sophisticated clients (Private Equity, Private Debt, Evergreen structures, Hybrid structures, Open-ended structures).
• Assume end‑to‑end responsibility for service delivery, ensuring compliance with SLAs, fund documentation, and regulatory requirements.
• Manage client expectations proactively and handle escalations independently before involving the Manager where required.
Build and maintain trusted, long‑term client relationships, participating in client meetings, onboarding calls, and post‑audit reviews.

Onboarding

During client onboarding, the Assistant Manager undertakes several crucial tasks to ensure a smooth transition and establish a productive relationship with the new client. Hereunder are some key responsibilities:

• Lead or actively support client onboardings, restructurings, migrations, and system set‑ups.
• Validate fund structures, valuation methodologies, fee models, and reporting frameworks in line with legal documents.
• Coordinate across internal teams (FA, TA, back office, Corporate, AIFM, Risk & Compliance, IT etc) to ensure seamless implementation.
• Review and sign‑off data migration and initial NAVs.

NAV Oversight & Technical Review

During Net Asset Value (NAV) oversight, the Assistant Manager play a critical role in ensuring accuracy, compliance, and smooth operations. Hereunder are some key responsibilities:

• Assume overall accountability for the NAV oversight framework across the assigned client portfolio, ensuring accuracy, consistency, timeliness, and compliance with fund documentation, accounting standards, and regulatory requirements.
• Oversee the end‑to‑end NAV production cycle, including capital activity, income recognition, valuation inputs, investor allocations, and fee calculations.
• Perform in‑depth technical reviews and approvals of complex NAVs, including:

o Private equity, private debt, evergreen funds, and multi‑compartment structures
o Complex instruments (loans, profit‑participating notes, derivatives, look‑through investments)
o FX treatments, waterfalls, and performance fee mechanisms
• Act as a technical reference point on Lux GAAP, IFRS, consolidation and structure‑specific treatments.

• Ensure all NAV‑related deliverables meet agreed Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and internal quality standards.
• Maintain strong documentation standards, including working papers, reconciliation files, and management review evidence, to support both internal controls and external audit requirements.
• Support the preparation of financial statements inputs by ensuring consistency between NAVs, accounting records, and statutory reporting.

Risk Management, Controls & Audit

• Act as a key control owner for the assigned client portfolio, ensuring that fund accounting activities are performed in line with internal policies, ISAE requirements, regulatory obligations, and client documentation.
• Ensure that appropriate preventive and detective controls are in place, operating effectively, and evidenced.
• Review and challenge unusual transactions, valuation judgments, late data, or deviations from standard processes.
• Act as the primary escalation point for NAV issues, breaches, or errors, ensuring timely resolution, root‑cause analysis, and clear documentation.
• Act as the primary liaison for external auditors, managing audit queries and timelines.
• Support the Manager in maintaining a strong control culture across the team and client portfolio.

Team Leadership & People Management

• Provide day‑to‑day supervision of Senior Fund Accountants and Fund Accountants within the team.
• Allocate work effectively, taking into account complexity, risk and deadlines.
• Review deliverables prepared by the team and provide structured feedback.
• Support training, development, and performance management of team members.
• Promote a culture of accountability, ownership, collaboration, and quality.
• Escalate capacity, performance, or quality concerns to the Manager with proposed solutions.

Process Improvement & Operational Excellence

• Continuously assess existing fund accounting and reporting processes to identify inefficiencies, risks, and improvement opportunities.
• Actively contribute to system enhancements, automation, and standardisation.
• Support the Manager in implementing new operating models, tools, and best practices.
• Encourage a culture of continuous improvement and risk awareness

Required Experience / Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or Economics
• ACCA (or equivalent) – qualified or advanced stage preferred
• Strong knowledge of Lux GAAP and IFRS (including consolidation)
• 8+ years of experience in fund administration, primarily for closed-ended funds, open-ended funds and evergreen/hybrid funds, with experience in various asset classes (private equity, private debt, listed loans)
• Prior experience reviewing NAVs and supervising team members is essential.
• Experience in capital hedging and portfolio management.
• Added value for candidates familiar with public loans managed through Allvue or WSO platforms.
• Languages: English fluent; French and/or German is an advantage.
• Additional advantage for candidates with experience using Paxus.

Skills/Behavior

In addition to demonstrating IQEQ's Group Values (Authentic, Bold, Collaborative), the Assistant Manager is expected to:

• Take ownership and accountability
• Demonstrate sound judgement and risk awareness
• Lead and develop others
• Communicate clearly with senior stakeholders
• Navigate complexity and ambiguity
• Balance client service with internal control discipline
• Plan, prioritise, and delegate effectively
• Continuously develop technical and leadership skills

Are you passionate about research? So are we! Come and join us
The Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST) is a leading Research and Technology Organisation (RTO) that drives innovation for the economy and society in Luxembourg and beyond. With cutting-edge expertise in Natural, Built, Industrial environments, Space, AI, Security and defence technologies. LIST bridges scientific excellence and applied research to design solutions that address real-world challenges and create positive impact.
Do you want to know more about LIST? Check our website: https://www.list.lu/

How will you contribute?
As part of the Biotechnology Unit, and particularly the Bioformulation Group, you will contribute to the machine learning assisted structure-function study of soluble dietary fibres (galactomannans) isolated from underexplored leguminous seed bioresources in the framework of the ENTANGLE FNR funded project. You will develop clean label procedures to extract and isolate galactomannans from forage legume seed biomass such as alfalfa and clover. In addition, the successful candidate is expected to determine the technofunctional and prebiotic potential of native and enzymatically modified derivatives benchmarked to commercial biopolymer targets.

As a Postdoctoral Researcher, you will mainly be responsible for:
• Extracting, isolating and purifying galactomannans from forage legume seeds
• Enzymatically tailor the chemical structure and technofunctional profile of native galactomannans
• Determine the structure conformational, technological and prebiotic potential of the native and modified galactomannans and
• Promoting and disseminating your research work through high-quality scientific publications in peer-reviewed journals, oral and poster presentations in conferences, and patents.
If you are specialised in food biopolymers, colloids science, and/or food process engineering, with a strong foundation in soft-matter physics and a focus on understanding and tailoring structure–property–function relationships for innovative food applications, please apply and join our new and dynamic team.

The University of Luxembourg is an international research university with a distinctly multilingual and interdisciplinary character.
The Faculty of Law, Economics and Finance counts over 2,700 students enrolled across four Bachelor programmes, thirteen Master programmes, doctoral studies as well as several continuing education courses. The Faculty hosts the Doctoral School of Law and the Doctoral School in Economics, Finance and Management.
Teaching and research at the FDEF benefit from the proximity of European institutions, Luxembourg's leading international financial centre, as well as its vibrant business community. Institutional and private sector partnerships, sponsored chairs and a growing network of international partner universities make the FDEF a dynamic academic hub at the heart of Europe.

Your role
The successful candidate will strengthen the Department of Law's research area in Banking, Financial and Commercial Law, which is a cornerstone of the Department's academic profile and a key contributor to the University's reputation. They will pursue research and teaching in this field, focussing on Luxembourg, EU, and comparative transnational perspectives. The position is of particular strategic relevance given the Department's ambition to maintain its leadership in financial law, a domain central to Luxembourg's role as a global financial centre.
The ideal candidate shows potential to:
• Develop an internationally recognized research profile in banking law in a broad sense, e.g., prudential regulation and bank supervision, depositary law, regulation of payments and payment systems, financial technologies, sustainable finance, secured transactions and consumer financial contracts, links to financial markets law
• Publish extensively in top-tier peer-reviewed journals, monographs, or authoritative treatises
• Contribute to interdisciplinary initiatives such as the FutureFinTechNCER and/or collaborate with the Department of Finance in the field of sustainable finance

• Cover legal frameworks at both EU and Luxembourg levels, adopting a comparative approach that includes neighbouring jurisdictions and other global financial centres

• Show and develop leadership potential

They will actively contribute to the University's “Third Mission” by engaging with Luxembourg and EU financial law, and will be encouraged to develop into a leadership role within the Department. This position offers the opportunity to gain recognition and respect in Luxembourg's legal community, renowned for its emphasis on financial law expertise and its strong integration of academic insight with professional practice. Description

At Amazon, we're working to be the most customer-centric company on earth. One customer experience that we're constantly looking to take to a new level is how we fulfil and deliver customer orders. As a Supply Chain Manager in Amazon Extra Large (AMXL) EU, you will work closely with multiple stakeholders across Amazon, from operational teams who are fulfilling customer orders to retail teams and everything in between. To succeed in this role, you need to be comfortable making business decisions in a fast-paced and evolving work environment and partnering with various functional teams and individuals at all levels of the organisation. This role will include a mix of long-term strategic projects and short-term tactical scope. You will bring strong business judgment, deep curiosity about how things work, strong written and oral communication skills, and a passion for creating effective processes and mechanisms that scale.
The role is responsible for the Production Planning, Labour Planning, and Capacity Execution function for AMXL EU, and is located in our Luxembourg Amazon HQ office, with Barcelona corporate offices also available as an option.

Being a Supply Chain Manager for Amazon involves lots of problem solving. You'll work with a number of teams to navigate challenges as and when situations impact our network. title: PhD CANDIDATE IN SOCIAL CRITERIA DRIVEN ABSOLUTE ENVIRONMENTAL.... (m/f)
employer: Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology - LIST
description:
Fixed term contract | Belvaux | 48 months

Are you passionate about research? So are we! Come and join us

The Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST) is a leading Research and Technology Organisation (RTO) that drives innovation for the economy and society in Luxembourg and beyond. With cutting-edge expertise in Natural, Built, Industrial environments, Space, AI, Security and defence technologies. LIST bridges scientific excellence and applied research to design solutions that address real-world challenges and create positive impact.

The Environmental Sustainability Assessment and Circularity (SUSTAIN) Unit conducts cross disciplinary research to support the transition toward a more sustainable, resilient, and healthy society. SUSTAIN combines expertise in environmental sciences, circular economy, risk and safety assessment, and sustainable innovation to address complex challenges related to human and environmental health, climate change, and resource efficiency, developing knowledge, methods, and transferable software for the simulation and comprehensive sustainability assessment of socio-economic systems. Its purpose is to foster sustainable eco-innovation, through products and technologies, as well as support sustainability-oriented policy implementation and behavioural change to promote decarbonisation transitions.

Do you want to know more about LIST? Check our website: https://www.list.lu/

How will you contribute?

The world faces a convergence of crises that are transforming the conditions for human development. Climate instability, ecosystem degradation, and the overuse of natural resources have reached critical levels, while social inequality, political fragmentation, and technological disruption are reshaping societies. Traditional notions of economic competitiveness, centred on growth and productivity, are being redefined to include social resilience, inclusiveness, and ecological integrity. Responding to this “polycrisis” requires new pathways that reconcile prosperity with planetary and social limits. Luxembourg offers a particularly illustrative example of these tensions. The country enjoys one of the highest income levels globally and a dynamic financial and business environment that sustains its reputation for economic success. Yet this prosperity depends strongly on cross-border commuting, which creates mobility challenges and environmental stress. Escalating housing prices have made access to affordable living increasingly difficult, displacing a significant share of the workforce beyond national borders. The reliance on imported energy leaves households and firms vulnerable to external shocks. Although Luxembourg's welfare model and social dialogue remain robust, they are under pressure from rising costs of living, widening inequalities, and growing demands on public services. Environmentally, Luxembourg's footprint per inhabitant ranks among the largest worldwide, driven by high consumption and land-use pressures that push the country beyond sustainable limits.

Meeting these intertwined challenges calls for coordinated transformations that bridge sectors, disciplines, and scales. Economic and social progress must be reframed within the concept of a Safe Operating Space—an area in which human well-being is achieved without breaching environmental boundaries. The objective is to steer innovation, governance, and everyday practices toward forms of competitiveness that are compatible with sustainability, rather than in conflict with it. The Doctoral Training Unit C-SOS (Competitiveness within a Safe Operating Space) is designed to cultivate researchers capable of analysing and fostering such transformations. It brings together an interdisciplinary consortium to train 12 PhD candidates in the assessment and design of inclusive and sustainable development trajectories. The programme equips them with conceptual and methodological tools to connect environmental sustainability, social well-being, and economic dynamics into integrated frameworks for decision-making. Its ambition is to inform socio-economic policies, encourage responsible industrial and technological innovation, and contribute to more equitable and resilient societies. Luxembourg provides an ideal environment for this initiative, combining strong expertise in sustainability science and policy analysis. The DTU is a collaboration between researchers at the Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST), the University of Luxembourg (UL) and the Urban Development and Mobility Department at the Luxembourg Institute of Socio-Economic Research (LISER). The consortium also includes the National Statistics Office (STATEC). In this DTU, 12 scientists will train 12 PhD students over six years (from January 2027), each obtaining a PhD from UL's doctoral schools.

As part of the C-SOS Doctoral Training Unit, in this PhD you will integrate concepts from Post-Growth, Sufficiency and Doughnut Economics into the downscaling of planetary boundaries, leveraging good examples of application to territories and cities. Possible research questions include: how to couple ecological limits and social foundation as an interdependent system? How to define social foundation? How to allocate the carrying capacity based on social foundation?.

You will be embedded in the SUSTAIN unit at LIST and enrolled as a doctoral candidate at the University of Luxembourg. You will work closely with a diverse cohort of 12 PhD researchers across the social, economic, and environmental sciences, contributing to a shared research agenda on how Luxembourg can thrive within its fair share of planetary limits

You will be mainly in charge of:
• Conducting a systematic review and critical assessment of existing carrying capacity allocation and planetary boundary downscaling approaches, spanning economic and emission based allocation methods, sufficiency based approaches, and Doughnut Economics frameworks
• Developing a methodological framework for coupling ecological limits and social foundation as an interdependent system, integrating Post-Growth, Sufficiency, and Doughnut Economics concepts into the downscaling of planetary boundaries
• Applying the framework to Luxembourg and comparable small territories under a range of allocation scenarios, drawing on Green Deal technology targets, context specific Decent Living Standards, and provisioning systems, producing environmental ceiling estimates grounded in social foundation thresholds
• Building and maintaining a dynamic system model enabling the testing of individual and combined allocation approaches, valuing social outcome generation per unit of environmental impact across relevant planetary boundary dimensions
• Collaborating with other C-SOS doctoral researchers, in particular those working on social foundation, Quality of Life, and economic systems, to ensure that allocation approaches rest on socially realistic and empirically coherent definitions of social foundation
• Publishing results in peer reviewed journals and presenting at international conferences
• Contributing to C-SOS training activities, workshops, and stakeholder engagement events
Is Your profile described below? Are you our future colleague? Apply now!

title: RESEARCHER IN FIRST-PRINCIPLES MODELLING OF MULTIFERROIC MATERIALS (m/f)
employer: Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology - LIST
description:
Fixed term contract | Belvaux | 24 months

Are you passionate about research? So are we! Come and join us

The Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST) is a leading Research and Technology Organisation (RTO) that drives innovation for the economy and society in Luxembourg and beyond. With cutting-edge expertise in Natural, Built, Industrial environments, Space, AI, Security and defence technologies. LIST bridges scientific excellence and applied research to design solutions that address real-world challenges and create positive impact.

Do you want to know more about LIST? Check our website: https://www.list.lu/

How will you contribute?

The push to reduce global energy consumption has set a clear trend in modern technology towards devices that are smaller, faster and more energy-efficient. Meeting these demands calls for new materials that can perform several functions at once. Magnetoelectric multiferroics are especially attractive in this respect, because they combine magnetism and ferroelectricity in a single phase. Crucially, this opens the possibility of controlling magnetism with an electric field which could enable entirely new device architectures and transform modern computing and data storage. Despite decades of progress, this promise is hard to realise: in most known multiferroics the two orders only coexist well below room temperature, and many are difficult to integrate with standard semiconductor manufacturing. Turning multiferroics into a practical technology therefore requires identifying or designing new materials that show robust, coupled magnetism and ferroelectricity at room temperature and remain compatible with established fabrication processes.

This is the challenge at the heart of the SMART project funded by the FNR CORE programme and led by Natalya Fedorova. We offer a 2-year postdoc position in which you will use first-principles calculations (DFT) together with analytical modelling to design room-temperature multiferroics via doping of semiconductors. Working mainly with DFT, you will carry out a systematic analysis of electronic, structural, magnetic and ferroelectric properties of these materials - computing, for instance, ground-state magnetic configurations, magnetic exchange interactions, electric polarization and polarization-switching pathways. You will then combine these results with analytical models to describe the magnetoelectric coupling in the most promising candidates and to explore how their magnetism could be manipulated with an applied electric field.

You will join the Modelling of Functional Materials group led by Jorge Íñiguez-González (also involved in the project) and will benefit from interactions with other team members.

You'll be working on a production-grade Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) system purpose-built for second-level controls on NAV computation in investment funds. ·          Build evaluation frameworks measuring control accuracy (error detection rate, false positive/negative rates on flagged discrepancies) and the quality of generated audit reports
·          Optimise vector database indexing for regulatory document corpora with high update frequency, ensuring fast retrieval as new CSSF/ESMA guidance is published

·          Explore cross-lingual retrieval for EU regulatory documents published across multiple languages, with emphasis on French and German variants of CSSF and ESMA guidance
·          Research agent-based simulation of NAV calculation steps, investigating how LLMs can reason reliably over arithmetic-sensitive regulatory workflows and signal confidence levels
·          Experiment with multi-agent orchestration for second-level control workflows, where agents decompose a NAV control task into parallel verification sub-tasks across pricing, accruals, and corporate actions.

title: (Senior) Risk Manager (Betriebswirt/in (Hochschule))
employer: Commerz Real AG Commerz Real Düsseldorf
description:
Willkommen im Team als

(Senior) Risk Manager

Das Unternehmen:

Die Commerz Real Fundmanagement S.à r.l. (“CRFM“) ist ein Spezialist für die Verwaltung von Alternativen Investmentfonds. Die CRFM trägt hierdurch zum Profil der Commerz Real AG und ihren Konzerngesellschaften (“Commerz Real Gruppe“) als integrierter Investmentdienstleister bei. Die CRFM arrangiert Alternative Investmentfonds, insbesondere für Immobilien, Infrastrukturprojekte, Anlagen zur Erzeugung erneuerbarer Energien sowie Großmobilien (wie z.B.: Flugzeuge, Schiffe und Schienenfahrzeuge). Die CRFM ist eine Tochtergesellschaft der Commerz Real AG, die ihrerseits eine Tochter der Commerzbank Aktiengesellschaft, Deutschland, ist.

Aufgabe:

- Als (Senior) Risk Manager Anlageprodukte und Teil des Risk Management Teams bist Du verantwortlich für die Risikoanalyse, Bewertung und Überwachung von (komplexen) Neu- und Bestandsgeschäften unter Beachtung von wirtschaftlichen, rechtlichen und steuerlichen Rahmenbedingungen hinsichtlich aller relevanten Risikoarten (u.a. Adressausfall-, Objektwertänderungs-, Marktpreis-, Liquiditätsrisiken, spezielle Risiken im Bereich Infrastructure wie z.B. Betriebs- und Projektentwicklungsrisiken, etc.)
- Dabei stellst Du die kompetenzgerechte Genehmigung bzw. Erstellung von Genehmigungsvorlagen für An- und Verkaufstransaktionen der AIF/Spezial-AIF sicher
- Zu Deinen Aufgaben gehört auch die Mitarbeit bei der Strukturierung und Steuerung von AIF/Spezial-AIF zur haftungsmäßigen und wirtschaftlichen Optimierung
- Ebenso verantwortest Du die regelmäßige risikotechnische Überwachung der AIF/Spezial-AIF im Wertschöpfungsprozess inkl. Überwachung der vertraglichen Finanzierungsgestaltung und des Liquiditätsmanagements
- Du unterstützt die Marktbereiche bei Vertragsverhandlungen im Neu- und Bestandsgeschäft sowie bei der Entwicklung von neuen Produkten als Mitglied in Dealteams und/oder Projektgruppen
- Die Leitung von bzw. Mitarbeit in bereichsinternen Projekten zur Optimierung / Digitalisierung der Risikoorganisation, hier insbesondere zur (Weiter-)Entwicklung von gesetzeskonformen Prozessen, Regularien und Risikotools gehört ebenfalls zu Deinen Aufgaben
- Du bringst Deine Expertise und Unterstützung bei übergreifenden Projekten sowie im Rahmen der Digitalisierungsstrategie ein. Dabei übernimmst Du auch die Leitung von übergreifenden Projekten
- Du übernimmst Coaching / Weiterbildungsaufgaben im Risikomanagement sowie die Ausbildung von Nachwuchskräften

Profil:

- Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes (auch berufsintegriertes) Studium mit der Fachrichtung Wirtschaftswissenschaften oder Rechtswissenschaften, idealerweise im Schwerpunkt Risikomanagement
- Langjährige fachbezogene Berufserfahrung im Bereich Risikomanagement eines Asset-Managers, eines Fondsemissionshauses oder eines Kreditinstitutes,
- Umfassende Kenntnisse und mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Assetklasse Infrastructure, idealerweise auch in Private Equity und Debt Strukturen. Grundkenntnisse und Interesse an den Assetklassen Renewable Energies, sowie Real Estate runden Deine Erfahrung ab.
- Erweiterte betriebswirtschaftliche Kenntnisse insbesondere im Bereich Risikomanagement, Bilanzanalyse, Discounted Cash-Flow-Analyse, Sensitivitätsanalyse, Cash-Flow-Modellierung, Liquiditätsrisikomanagement und Portfoliosteuerung
- Sehr gute Kenntnisse der einschlägigen Gesetze, Verordnungen, Vorschriften und Richtlinien (AIFM-Richtlinie, AIFM-VO, ESMA-Leitlinien, Luxemburger Gesetze bzgl. AIFMD, u.a.)
- Ausgeprägte analytische Fähigkeiten und sehr sicherer Umgang mit MS Office
- Gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift, idealerweise auch gute Französischkenntnisse
- Ausgeprägte Team- und Kommunikationsfähigkeit
- Hohes Maß an Zielstrebigkeit und Eigeninitiative sowie unternehmerisches Denken und Flexibilität

About the FSTM
The University of Luxembourg is an international research university with a distinctly multilingual and interdisciplinary character.
The Faculty of Science, Technology and Medicine (FSTM) at the University of Luxembourg contributes multidisciplinary expertise in the fields of Mathematics, Physics, Engineering, Computer Science, Life Sciences and Medicine.
Through its dual mission of teaching and research, the FSTM seeks to generate and disseminate knowledge and train new generations of responsible citizens in order to better understand, explain and advance society and the environment we live in.
The Department of Engineering (DoE) is a dynamic, interdisciplinary group engaged in civil, electrical, mechanical engineering and operations research/management, driving forward innovative research and solutions. It also has an internationally leading profile in computational science and engineering. We develop cutting-edge technologies, promoting the sustainable and economical use of resources, and meeting the technological demands of Luxembourg, the Greater Region, and beyond. Nearly all research projects are supported by a network of national and international partnerships, several with public or industrial stakeholders. At the University, the Department cooperates across faculties and with the interdisciplinary centres. In particular, the new interdisciplinary centre focused on complex environmental systems opens up significant opportunities for future collaborations.
The Department of Engineering seeks to hire a Research Support Engineer to integrate the Technical Support Unit (TSU). The candidate will work closely with the TSU Team Leader and technicians to support the DoE members (PhD students, Post-doctoral researchers, professors), in their research activities, specially in the fields of Concrete, Steel, Composite and Geotechnical structures. The candidate will work both in Kirchberg and Belval Campus.

Your role
• Assist the research support engineers in scientific test preparation and execution, analysis and preparation of experimental data, setup of new equipment and test procedures
• Planification and execution of testing cf. to relevant standards
• Definition and installation of measurement instrumentation
• Production of samples: un molding, preparing, placing reinforcement, concrete mixing and casting
• Handling of samples: measure, weigh, process, store
• Housekeeping of the laboratories:
o Updating the inventories: spare parts, sensors, scientific equipment
o Cleaning and maintaining the laboratory equipment
o Archiving, storing of documentation, samples
o Waste management: recycling, disposing off



Your profile
• Junior engineer with a master degree, preferably in civil engineering
• Experience in lab support in industry and/or academia
• Ability in executing standard workshop jobs. e.g., concrete casting
• Adaptability and willingness to learn new skills
• Ability to work proactively, independently
• Team spirit, dynamism and sense of initiative
• Flexibility
• Good command of MS Office tools: Outlook, Word, Excel
• Excellent command (C1) of English is required. Good working knowledge (B1) of French, German and Luxembourgish would be an advantage

We offer
• A modern, dynamic university with a personal and inclusive atmosphere. Multilingual and international character. Staff coming from more than 90 countries. Member of The Guild of European Research Intensive Universities
• An exceptional research environment, supported by skilled staff and high-quality equipment. Strong links to professional sectors and the Luxembourg labour market. A unique urban campus with excellent infrastructure
• A partner for society and industry. Cooperation with European institutions, innovative companies, the Financial Centre and a wide range of non-academic partners including ministries, local governments, associations, and NGOs

• Cover letter
Early application is highly encouraged, as the applications will be processed upon reception. Please apply ONLINE formally through the HR system. Applications by Email will not be considered.
All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply. In line with our values, the University of Luxembourg promotes an inclusive culture. We encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds and are dedicated to upholding equality and respect for our employees and students.

Job Description & Summary

Pwc Luxembourg is hiring a Manager Customs & Trade Facilitation, Government and Public Sector Advisory (m/f/d). What if it was you?  
Your mission: As a Manager in our Government and Public Sector Advisory team, you will lead strategy and transformation engagements at the intersection of international trade, customs governance, and digital modernisation. Our clients are customs administrations, customs unions, ministries, and international institutions (EU, GCC, WBG, UN and beyond) seeking to transform, modernise, and align with international trade facilitation standards. This is a full-time, on-site position based in Luxembourg, with frequent international travel.

Be a part of our team where you will:  

• Lead and deliver consulting engagements for customs and tax administrations, customs unions, and international institutions, covering transformation, modernisation, and trade facilitation reform agendas;
• Take ownership of projects in the domain of Single Window, interoperability, and data exchange workstreams, advising clients on architecture, governance, applicable international standards (e.g. WCO Data Model, UN/CEFACT), and implementation roadmaps;
• Design and deliver training, capacity-building, and knowledge-transfer programmes for public-sector counterparts in EU and donor-funded projects;
• Manage client relationships, contribute to proposal writing and business development, and represent the team in client workshops, international conferences, and working groups;
• Coach junior consultants and trainees, structure complex multi-workstream engagements, and ensure the quality and consistency of deliverables (reports, frameworks, presentations).

Let's talk about you. If you …
  
• Have at least 10 years of relevant experience in trade facilitation, customs modernisation, or Single Window implementation, including assignments delivered for or with public administrations and international organisations (e.g. UN, WCO, WTO, EU, WBG, regional development banks);
• Bring hands-on expertise in areas such as Single Window design and implementation, customs IT systems architecture, customs-to-customs data exchange, or cross-border digital trade, with a solid understanding of international standards (WCO, UN/CEFACT, WTO TFA);
• Have a strong track record in stakeholder engagement, including delivering trainings, speaking at international conferences or technical working groups, and contributing to thought leadership (articles, studies, working papers) in trade facilitation;
• Demonstrate an entrepreneurial mindset, with the ability to structure engagements from scratch, develop new client opportunities, and operate with a high level of autonomy, while being open to frequent international travel;
• Communicate fluently in English, both written and spoken (additional languages such as French, Modern Standard Arabic, or Luxembourgish are considered an asset);

…You are the candidate we are looking for!

PwC Luxembourg (www.pwc.lu) is the largest professional services firm in Luxembourg with over 3,600 people employed from 90 different countries. PwC Luxembourg provides audit, tax and advisory services including management consulting, transaction, financing and regulatory advice. The firm provides advice to a wide variety of clients from local and middle market entrepreneurs to large multinational companies operating from Luxembourg and the Greater Region. The firm supports its clients in creating the value they are looking for by contributing to the smooth operation of the capital markets and providing advice through an industry-focused approach.

At PwC, we help clients build trust and reinvent so they can turn complexity into competitive advantage. We're a tech-forward, people-empowered network with more than 364,000 people in 136 countries and 137 territories. Across audit and assurance, tax and legal, deals and consulting, we help clients build, accelerate, and sustain momentum. Find out more at www.pwc.com and www.pwc.lu.

title: Group General Counsel - International Company (m/f)
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

Group General Counsel

Reporting line: Chief Executive Officer, with dotted reporting line to the Board.
Contract: permanent, full-time (40 hours per week). Location: Luxembourg, hybrid, with regular international travel.

1 The business and the role

The company operates an international online subscription and creator platform, with exposure to adult content, and which operates across the United Kingdom, the European Union and the US. The Group General Counsel is the most senior legal officer of the group.

2 Main responsibilities

1. Legal function leadership and Board support

• Build, staff and lead the group legal function, including recruitment, budget, external counsel panel and legal operations.
• Act as principal legal adviser to the Board, the founders and the executive team, and attend Board and committee meetings.
• Set and own the group's legal risk appetite, escalation framework and legal reporting to the Board and to investors.
• Manage disputes and litigation across jurisdictions, including instruction and supervision of external counsel.

2. Corporate, M&A and governance

• Lead corporate and M&A transactions end to end, including target assessment, due diligence, transaction documentation, signing, closing and PMI.
• Support fundraising rounds, investor documentation, shareholder arrangements and cap table matters.
• Own corporate governance across a multi-jurisdictional holding structure, including entity management, board and shareholder resolutions, statutory filings, registers of beneficial owners, delegated authority frameworks and group policies.
• Act as secretary to the Board and to group entity boards, or supervise that function.
• Coordinate with finance and tax on group structuring, intragroup agreements, transfer pricing documentation and substance requirements.

3. Data protection, artificial intelligence and digital regulation

• Own the group's data protection compliance programme under the EU GDPR and the UK GDPR, including records of processing, transfer mechanisms, data protection impact assessments, data subject rights, breach response and supervisory authority engagement.
• Advise on US privacy legislation applicable to the group's user base, including state level comprehensive privacy laws and applicable wiretapping and tracking technology claims.
• Own the group's artificial intelligence governance framework, including the classification of AI systems, transparency obligations for synthetic and AI generated content, model and vendor due diligence, training data and intellectual property questions, and readiness for the EU AI Act.
• Advise on the EU Digital Services Act and the UK Online Safety Act, including notice and action mechanisms, trusted flaggers, transparency reporting, risk assessment obligations, illegal content duties and children's access assessments.
• Advise on the EU Digital Markets Act, the audiovisual media services framework and platform to business regulation as applicable to the group's distribution channels.

4. High risk industry, trust and safety, and content compliance

• Advise on the legal and regulatory framework applicable to adult oriented and creator monetization platforms, including age assurance and identity verification, performer consent and record keeping obligations, nonconsensual intimate image takedown, CSAM prevention and reporting, and content moderation and appeals.
• Design and maintain creator terms, model releases, content licences, revenue share arrangements and agency and management arrangements.
• Advise on advertising, affiliate and performance marketing arrangements, influencer marketing rules and consumer protection requirements in the EU, the UK and the US.
• Manage intellectual property, including trademarks, copyright enforcement and anti-piracy programmes.

5. Payments, financial crime and sanctions

• Own the legal side of the group's payments stack, including acquirer and payment service provider agreements, alternative payment methods, payout and creator disbursement arrangements and merchant of record structures.
• Advise on card scheme rules as they apply to high risk and adult merchant categories, including high brand risk and integrity risk registration programmes, prohibited content rules, chargeback thresholds and remediation plans.
• Advise on PSD2 and strong customer authentication, electronic money and payment institution perimeter questions, and the implications of the EU instant payments and payment services reform.
• Own the group's KYC, AML, CTF and sanctions framework, including creator onboarding, transaction monitoring, and screening against EU, UK, US OFAC and other relevant measures.

6. Commercial and employment

• Negotiate the group's material commercial agreements, including technology, content, distribution, partnership and vendor agreements.
• Support the people function on employment law across multiple jurisdictions, including contracts, contractor classification, incentive schemes and internal investigations.

3 Required profile

The following are requirements (must-haves):

• Law degree from an EU or EEA or UK university.
• Admission in good standing to the bar of an EU or EEA Member State or UK.
• A minimum of 20 years of PQE legal experience, of which at least 10 years in a senior in house legal leadership role (General Counsel, Head of Legal or equivalent).
• Demonstrable experience of building and leading an international in house legal team across diverse jurisdictions.
• A track record of leading cross border M&A transactions in the US, UK and/or EU jurisdictions.
• Corporate governance experience in complex international structures.
• Recognised privacy certification (IAPP CIPP/E or equivalent) and hands on ownership of a GDPR compliance programme.
• Direct working knowledge of the EU/UK digital regulatory framework, including DSA, DMA, OSA, the AI Act, AVMS.
• Substantive experience in high risk regulated industries, and specifically in adult entertainment or creator platform compliance.
• Substantive experience of payment processing and billing for high-risk merchant categories.
• Experience in entertainment and media.
• Tax, KYC/AML and sanctions experience in a regulated or high risk environment.
• Experience advising founders, C level executives and Boards in a venture backed, high growth environment.
• English at level C (native/bilingual/proficient user).

The following are advantages (nice to haves):

• Postgraduate business qualification (MBA or equivalent).
• Formal training or certification in AI
• Recognised corporate governance certification (e.g. ILA CGO).
• Qualification or formal training in international taxation and in corporate compliance.
• Experience of a Luxembourg holding structure and of Luxembourg corporate and employment law.
• Additional languages, in particular Spanish, French, Portuguese, German or Luxembourgish.
• Prior experience in a matrix organisation or in the country or regional unit of a multinational group.

4 Personal attributes

• Commercial and pragmatic. Comfortable taking a risk-based position and defending it to the Board.
• Comfortable operating hands on in a lean team while also delegating and developing others.
• Able to work across cultures and time zones, and to hold credibility with founders, investors, regulators and counterparties.
• Willing to work in a business whose content categories include adult material.

5 Terms

• Contract: permanent (contrat à durée indéterminée), governed by Luxembourg law.
• Working time: full time, 40 hours per week, flexible arrangement.
• Place of work: [LuxCo address], Luxembourg, with hybrid working and regular travel, principally to London.
• Remuneration: gross annual salary between EUR 150,000 and EUR 250,000.
• Start date: as soon as possible.
• Pre appointment requirements: bulletin N°3 of the criminal reco [...]

title: Tech Lead - Digital Transformation Factory Vie (m/f)
description:
Tech Lead - Digital Transformation Factory Vie

Location Leudelange
Experience Level Professionnels

Votre job en bref

Au sein de la Digital Transformation Factory Vie, vous portez la vision technique des solutions digitales du domaine Vie et accompagnez l'équipe dans la conception, le développement et l'exploitation de solutions robustes, sécurisées, simples et maintenables.
En tant que point de référence technique, vous veillez à la cohérence des choix réalisés avec les besoins métier, l'écosystème IT, les standards de l'entreprise et les principes d'architecture. Vous collaborez étroitement avec les équipes de développement, les Business Analysts, le Product Owner, les architectes et les équipes d'exploitation, tout en conservant une dimension opérationnelle avec environ 50 % de votre activité consacrée au développement, selon les priorités de l'équipe.

Ce qui vous attend

Type de contrat : CDI
Type d'emploi : temps plein

• Vision et architecture : définir les orientations techniques locales en cohérence avec l'architecture d'entreprise et les architectes solution, promouvoir des solutions simples et maintenables, et garantir la cohérence entre les frontends Angular, les services REST backend .NET, les microservices de support et les échanges Kafka.
• Analyser en amont les impacts, dépendances et risques techniques, documenter les décisions structurantes et contribuer à la roadmap technique.
• Consulter les architectes et débattre avec eux de toute décision ayant un impact sur plusieurs applications ou équipes.
• Qualité logicielle : garantir la qualité des développements, la conformité aux standards techniques et la maîtrise de la dette technique ; intégrer les risques techniques et accompagner leur résolution.
• Réaliser des revues de code, prototypes et preuves de concept, intervenir sur les développements structurants ou complexes, veiller au respect des quality gates SonarCloud et promouvoir les tests automatisés.
• Accompagnement de l'équipe : faire progresser les membres sur les pratiques de développement et DevOps, contribuer au recrutement et à la montée en compétence, accompagner les choix de conception et d'implémentation, faciliter les décisions collectives et arbitrer lorsque nécessaire.
• Industrialisation : assurer une veille technologique, maintenir et améliorer les pipelines d'intégration continue dans Azure DevOps Services et collaborer sur les processus de déploiement continu gérés dans Jenkins.
• Garantir un niveau d'observabilité adapté grâce aux logs, métriques, tableaux de bord et alertes, et participer aux mises en production nécessitant l'intervention de l'équipe technique.

Ce que nous attendons

• Diplôme supérieur en informatique ou en ingénierie logicielle.
• Expérience significative en développement logiciel dans l'écosystème .NET et avec Angular, ainsi que dans un rôle de point de référence ou de leadership technique incluant l'accompagnement de développeurs.
• Très bonne maîtrise de C#, de .NET et de son écosystème, notamment EF Core et SQL Server, idéalement sur une version récente telle que .NET 10.
• Très bonne maîtrise d'Angular et de TypeScript.
• Bonne connaissance de Git, des revues de code et des stratégies de gestion des branches, notamment Gitflow.
• Expérience dans la conception d'API, de microservices, d'architectures distribuées et de solutions de messaging avec Kafka.
• Maîtrise des enjeux de performance, de scalabilité, de résilience applicative, de sécurité et d'observabilité.
• Expérience d'Azure DevOps Services pour l'intégration continue et connaissance de Jenkins pour le déploiement.
• Leadership technique, pragmatisme, autonomie, écoute et esprit d'équipe ; capacité à communiquer, coacher, décider et gérer plusieurs priorités sans posture autoritaire.
• Français et anglais courants ; l'allemand et le luxembourgeois constituent des atouts.
• Une expérience dans les secteurs financier, assurantiel ou de la gestion de patrimoine constitue un atout.

À propos de Baloise

Nous sommes plus qu'une compagnie d'assurance traditionnelle : nous sommes le partenaire personnel de quiconque veut se sentir tout simplement en sécurité. Outre nos activités financières classiques, nous cherchons à innover et à créer des liens générateurs de valeur avec des partenariats et des start-ups. Nous considérons l'ère numérique comme une opportunité et aspirons à ce que notre offre de demain soit encore plus durable, plus innovante et plus orientée client. Vous voulez y participer ?

Nous vous donnons la liberté de poursuivre vos idées... Investissez-vous ! Remettez-nous en question ! Continuez à évoluer et à nous faire évoluer !  Tout ceci est possible grâce à notre culture de l'apprentissage et de l'erreur ainsi qu'à une communication d'égal à égal. Parce que ce n'est qu'ensemble que nous pourrons aller de l'avant.

title: Junior AML/KYC Officer (m/f)
description:
Junior AML/KYC Officer

Company Description

We're a leading Investor Services group offering end-to-end services in administration, accounting, reporting, regulatory and compliance needs of the investment sector worldwide. We employ a global workforce of 6,500+ people across 24 jurisdictions and have assets under administration (AUA) exceeding US$857 billion. We work with 13 of the world's top-15 private equity firms.

Our services are underpinned by a Group-wide commitment to ESG and best-in-class technology including a global data platform and innovative proprietary tools supported by in-house experts.

Above all, what makes us different is our people. Operating as trusted partners to our clients, we deliver intelligent solutions through a combination of technical expertise and strong relationships based on deep client understanding. 

We're driven by our Group purpose, to power people and possibilities.

Job Description

What You'll Do:

• You'll conduct AML/KYC reviews and prepare investor files for various entity types, including Individuals, Companies, Trusts, Foundations, and Regulated Entities.
• You'll ensure compliance with internal policies, regulatory requirements, and risk management standards throughout the onboarding process.
• You'll liaise with auditors, AIFMs, depositaries, compliance teams, and management to collect, review, and follow up on KYC documentation.
• You'll perform screening, filing, and verification of KYC records, while managing and responding to queries from internal and external stakeholders.
• You'll build strong client relationships, identify process improvement opportunities, and contribute to an efficient and customer-focused onboarding experience.

What we offer

• Comprehensive remuneration and pension: motivating financial packages based upon market rates for your role and is proportionate to your qualifications, level of experiences and skills profile
• Wellbeing: additional social benefits
• Flexible working: we recognise the value of working flexibly and want to ensure all employees enjoy an excellent work-life blend. As such, we are open to conversations with employees related to setting up flexible working arrangements.

Qualifications

About you:

• You hold a Bachelor's or master's degree in economics, Finance, or a related field, with recent graduation preferred.
• You bring 0-1 year of experience in AML/KYC, compliance, or a related function, a valuable asset to your success in this role.
• You are fluent in English, with proficiency in French or German considered an additional advantage.
• You demonstrate self-motivation and thrive as a collaborative team player who takes ownership of your work.

Additional information

OUR COMMITMENT TO YOU AND THE ENVIRONMENT

Sustainability is integral to our strategy and operations. Our sustainability depends on us building and maintaining long-term relationships with all our stakeholders – including our employees, clients, and local communities – while also reducing our impact on our natural environment.
There is always more we can, and should do, to improve – whether in relation to our people, our clients, our planet, or our governance. Our ongoing success as a business depends on our sustainability and agility in a changing and challenging global landscape. We're committed to fostering an inclusive, equitable and diverse culture for our people, led by our Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion steering committee.

Our learning and development programmes and systems (including PowerU and MyCampus) enable us to invest in growing our employees' careers, while our hybrid working approach supports our employees in achieving balance and flexibility while remaining connected to their colleagues. We want to empower our 6,500+ employees - from 94 nationalities, across 24 countries - to each achieve their potential.  Through IQ-EQ Launchpad we support women managers launching their first fund, in an environment where only 15% of all private equity and venture capital firms are gender balanced.

We're committed to growing relationships with our clients and supporting them in achieving their objectives. We understand that our clients' sustainability and success lead to our sustainability and success. We're emotionally invested in our clients right from the beginning.

title: Compliance Officer (h/f)
description:
Compliance Officer (H/F)

Sur un marché de plus en plus concurrentiel, le Groupe Foyer reste fidèle à ses valeurs : Confiance, Excellence, Innovation, Intégrité et Indépendance.

Dans le cadre du développement de ses activités en Assurance Vie Individuelle et Vie Groupe, nous recherchons un(e) Compliance Officer (H/F) afin de renforcer notre dispositif de conformité et d'accompagner les enjeux réglementaires de l'activité. Vous jouerez un rôle clé dans la mise en œuvre du cadre de conformité, notamment en matière de lutte contre le blanchiment de capitaux et le financement du terrorisme (AML/CFT).

Vos responsabilités :

• Assurer la conformité opérationnelle aux réglementations AML/CFT applicables au secteur de l'assurance vie.
• Analyser les dossiers clients lors de l'entrée en relation ainsi que lors des opérations effectuées sur les contrats.
• Participer à la mise en œuvre des plans de revue et de remédiation du portefeuille clients.
• Préparer, documenter et présenter les dossiers soumis aux comités d'acceptation.
• Conseiller et accompagner les équipes dans l'application des règles et procédures de conformité.
• Exécuter des contrôles réguliers de conformité et identifier les éventuels dysfonctionnements.
• Piloter et réaliser les contrôles de second niveau dans le cadre du plan de contrôle Compliance.
• Contribuer activement aux projets liés à la conformité, notamment en matière d'AML/CFT.
• Participer à la rédaction et à l'amélioration des procédures et modes opératoires relatifs à la conformité.
• Assister le Head of Compliance dans la préparation des reportings destinés aux instances dirigeantes et aux autorités de contrôle.
• Être force de proposition dans une démarche d'amélioration continue et participer à la mise en œuvre des actions retenues.

Votre profil :

• Vous êtes titulaire d'un Master en Économie, Droit, Finance ou équivalent.

description:

Transport manager (2 years contract)

• Zone PED 4801 Rodange, 4801 Rodange, Luxembourg

Job Description

The Transport Manager acts as the operational backbone and system Subject Matter Expert (SME) for outbound transportation execution across the EMENA network at Avery Dennison. Reporting to the Head of Transportation, this role bridges strategic regional transport objectives with daily execution—overseeing both direct customer deliveries and internal site movements.
The position combines technical system ownership (TRAX TMS & QAD ERP), master data governance, order/lead-time investigations, carrier integration management, and operational standardization across all regional manufacturing plants and distribution centers.

Key Responsibilities & Accountabilities

1. Transport System Governance & Network Master Data

• Lead-Time & Schedule Administration: Configure, validate, and maintain transport lead-time matrices per shipping site, destination country, and individual ship-to customer location across EMENA.
• Order Cut-Off & Departure Execution: Establish and maintain order entry cut-off times and daily departure schedules to align plant dispatch capabilities with carrier collection slots.
• Routing & Execution Logic: Maintain and optimize TRAX routing rules, logic parameters, and ship-via assignment rules per ship-to destination.
• Carrier & Partner Onboarding: Manage system setup and integration parameters for new logistics service providers following carrier tender allocation or carrier switches; maintain manual partner addresses as required.
• Documentation & Carrier EDI: Setup specific delivery instructions per ship-to to ensure dynamic printing on Weight-Lists and seamless EDI transmission to carriers; configure specialized invoicing setups (e.g., single weight-list per order rule).
• Network Availability & Calendars: Update and govern site and customer holiday closures to prevent system tendering errors and inaccurate delivery commitments.

2. ERP Integration & Analytical Investigations

• Custom Shipping Setup: Configure specialized shipping requirements in QAD, including the setup of "special pallet packlist" rules per ship-to upon request from Customer Service Representatives (CSRs).
• Lead-Time Root Cause Analysis: Conduct structured investigations into lead-time performance and anomalies (segmented by site, country, and ship-to) to resolve bottlenecks.
• Order Diagnostics: Lead end-to-end technical and operational investigations on delayed or stuck orders to identify system vs. operational execution root causes.

3. Outbound Network Governance & Service Excellence

• Oversee daily outbound freight flows, ensuring compliance with defined SLAs for customer deliveries and inter-site transfers.
• Track and report operational performance metrics (OTIF, OTD, weight-list compliance).
• Serve as the primary regional escalation contact for complex transport system failures, carrier delivery exceptions, and site logistics disruptions.
• Collaborate cross-functionally with Customer Experience (CSR), Manufacturing Operations, Warehouse Logistics, and Carriers.
Please note it's a 24 month contract.

Qualifications

• Education: Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Business Administration, or Systems Engineering.
• Experience: 5+ years of operational transportation management or logistics systems experience within a complex, multi-site European/EMENA environment.
• Systems Expertise: Hands-on experience with TRAX TMS and QAD ERP transport modules (or equivalent enterprise TMS/ERP combinations); solid understanding of carrier EDI integrations and weight-list/invoicing documentation.
• Skills: Strong analytical capabilities (root-cause analysis on orders and lead-times), continuous improvement mindset, cross-functional communication.
• Languages: Professional fluency in English; additional European languages (German, French, Dutch, Polish) are an advantage.

Additional Information

Here's a glimpse of the great benefits you can expect:

• Compensation & Benefits: Benefit from a labor agreement with salary increases, a qualified social minimum wage, and automatic salary indexation to inflation. Enjoy a seniority incentive, profit sharing, and a 13th-month salary (with the option to convert it into additional leave).
• Continuous Development: Access extensive training and certification opportunities, local mentorship programs, and leadership development initiatives (including development discussions and Talent Management programs).
• Flexibility & On-site Perks: Embrace flexible work arrangements for white-collar roles. Enjoy a subsidized canteen, an annual gift for employees and children, and a mobile app that centralizes services, benefits, vouchers, and discounts.

About us
The University of Luxembourg is an international research university with a distinctly multilingual and interdisciplinary character.
The University's main Library, the Luxembourg Learning Centre (LLC), located in the heart of the Belval campus, is much more than a library: it is a hub of innovation and knowledge designed to foster research, learning, collaboration and outreach. Its building, a true architectural masterpiece, combines the restructuring of an old industrial hall with bold contemporary design, and spans 14,000 m², 10.7 km of shelving and more a thousand working spaces. It stands as a prestigious façade for Luxembourg and for the University of Luxembourg, reflecting the ambition and academic excellence of both the country and the institution. Equipped with modern infrastructure and advanced technologies, the LLC offers a unique environment where students, researchers, and professionals come together to create, share and innovate. Complementing the central role of the LLC in Belval, a library hub specialising in European law research is located in the Weicker building, benefiting from its proximity to European institutions and Luxembourg's financial district.

Your role
We are looking for a specialist in the Library's strategic growth area of research support and information skills training. Based in Belval, with the opportunity to offer support and training at our other campus locations in Luxembourg, the person will be involved in developing new innovative research support services around research data management, in collaboration with colleagues and senior managers. You will also contribute to developing the information skills training programmes in partnership with the learning and teaching centres of the University. You will help to promote the development of the Library's emerging research support services.
Key Responsibilities:
• Contribute to the development and implementation of research support services, policies, and future service planning
• Provide specialist support for the University's research activities, with a priority on research data management, and additional support around open science, open access, bibliometrics, and scholarly communication
• Assist with the development and management of institutional data and publishing repositories, e.g. contributing to efforts in data quality, compliance with funder requirements, and timely deposit of research outputs
• Support day to day operations of the Library's Research Support team, including responding to enquiries and maintaining service documentation
• Develop and deliver training, workshops, and one to one consultations for researchers, students - bachelor, master and doctoral, and academic research support staff
• Establish and maintain strong working relationships with researchers and students, as well as across the Library and research support services, to establish requirements and inform service delivery
• Promote all research support services of the Library
• Contribute to the development of Library policies and practices
It is anticipated that 80% of the role involves outreach and development of research support services, and 20% of the role involves developing and providing training in information skills topics, e.g. research data management, information literacy and use of digital tools.

Your profile
• Master's degree or equivalent professional experience in an academic, research, digital, or information-intensive environment
• 3+ years' experience in research support environments with a focus on research data management
• In depth knowledge in research data management and related trends
• Library and/or teaching experience is an asset
• Excellent interpersonal and communication skills to engage diverse stakeholders and promote services
• A PhD is considered an asset
• Full proficiency in English; good knowledge of French or German would be an asset

We offer
• A modern, dynamic university with a personal and inclusive atmosphere. Multilingual and international character. Staff coming from more than 90 countries. Member of The Guild of European Research Intensive Universities
• An exceptional research environment, supported by skilled staff and high-quality equipment. Strong links to professional sectors and the Luxembourg labour market. A unique urban campus with excellent infrastructure
• A partner for society and industry. Cooperation with European institutions, innovative companies, the Financial Centre and a wide range of non-academic partners including ministries, local governments, associations, and NGOs

How to apply

• Cover letter

All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply. In line with our values, the University of Luxembourg promotes an inclusive culture. We encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds and are dedicated to upholding equality and respect for our employees and students.

• Acting as a trusted point of contact for employees and managers on HR administration, leave management, social security matters and employment-related questions;

• Coordinating maternity, parental and other family-related leaves, ensuring compliance with Luxembourg legislation and providing guidance to employees and managers;

• Managing working time, holiday entitlements and absence records, while ensuring accurate reporting and compliance with internal policies;
• Maintaining high-quality employee data in Workday and other HR systems, performing regular controls and contributing to reliable HR reporting;
• Supporting international mobility activities, including assignments, secondments, work permits, social security registrations and foreign office administration;
• Providing operational HR expertise and guidance to HR Business Partners and managers while ensuring compliance with legal and internal requirements;
• Contributing to the continuous improvement, simplification and digitalisation of HR processes, systems and employee self-service solutions;
• Producing meaningful HR metrics and insights to support decision-making and operational excellence.

Your profile:

• You have a minimum of 4 years of experience in HR Operations, HR Services or HR Administration;
• Good knowledge of Luxembourg labour law and social security procedures;
• Experience with employee lifecycle administration, leave management and HR data quality;
• Exposure to international HR administration and Workday, or another HRIS, would be an advantage;
• Strong service orientation, attention to detail and confidence working with HR systems and operational data;
• Reliable, proactive, discreet and comfortable interacting with employees, managers and internal and external stakeholders;
• Fluent in French and English. Additional languages are an asset.

title: Juriste – Droit des contrats & marchés publics (m/f/d)
description:
Votre mission

Chez Schroeder & Associés, le rôle du juriste ne se limite pas à émettre des avis juridiques. Vous serez directement impliqué(e) dans les projets, aux côtés de nos chefs de projet, ingénieurs et spécialistes, afin d'anticiper les enjeux contractuels et réglementaires, de sécuriser nos interventions et de contribuer activement à la recherche de solutions. Intégré(e) à notre équipe administrative, vous accompagnez nos équipes de projet sur les questions juridiques liées principalement au droit contractuel et aux marchés publics. À ce titre, vous serez notamment amené(e) à :

    accompagner et conseiller nos chefs de projet et équipes techniques tout au long des différentes phases des projets

    analyser, rédiger, adapter et négocier des contrats, conventions, avenants et autres documents contractuels

    accompagner activement les équipes dans la gestion contractuelle des projets et dans le traitement des problématiques rencontrées en cours d'exécution

    conseiller et assister nos équipes dans l'application de la législation luxembourgeoise relative aux marchés publics

    analyser les dossiers de consultation, cahiers des charges et autres documents liés aux procédures de marchés publics

    identifier et anticiper les risques juridiques et contractuels et proposer des solutions pragmatiques adaptées aux réalités des projets

    participer, lorsque nécessaire, aux réunions de projet et aux échanges avec les maîtres d'ouvrage, partenaires et autres intervenants

    contribuer à la rédaction de courriers, prises de position, réclamations et argumentaires à caractère juridique ou contractuel

    développer et mettre à disposition des équipes des modèles, outils et bonnes pratiques en matière contractuelle

    contribuer au développement des connaissances juridiques au sein du bureau par le conseil, la sensibilisation et la formation interne

    contribuer directement à la sécurisation contractuelle de nos activités et à la réussite de nos projets.

Votre rôle consiste ainsi non seulement à conseiller, mais également à agir aux côtés des équipes et à apporter votre expertise juridique directement dans la conduite des projets.
Votre profil

    Vous êtes titulaire d'un Master en droit et avez réussi les Cours complémentaires en droit luxembourgeois (CCDL)

    vous disposez de solides connaissances en droit des contrats et vous intéressez particulièrement à la législation et aux procédures relatives aux marchés publics

    une première expérience professionnelle au Luxembourg dans ces domaines constitue un avantage

    vous disposez d'une excellente capacité d'analyse et de rédaction et savez traduire des problématiques juridiques complexes en recommandations claires et pragmatiques

    vous maîtrisez parfaitement le français, tant à l'oral qu'à l'écrit

    la connaissance du luxembourgeois ainsi que des notions d'allemand constituent des atouts

    vous travaillez de manière structurée, rigoureuse, autonome et proactive

    vous appréciez le travail en équipe et êtes à l'aise dans un environnement multidisciplinaire

    vous maîtrisez les outils informatiques usuels, notamment MS Office.

Quelques plus

    Plus qu'une expertise juridique, nous recherchons une personne qui s'intéresse à nos projets

    Vous avez envie de comprendre ce qui se cache derrière un contrat : un bâtiment, un ouvrage d'art, une infrastructure, un projet d'aménagement ou un projet environnemental.

    Vous êtes curieux(se) du monde de la construction et de l'ingénierie et souhaitez en comprendre les enjeux techniques, organisationnels et humains.

    Vous appréciez le contact avec les équipes de projet et préférez rechercher avec elles une solution concrète plutôt que de vous limiter à formuler un avis juridique.

    Vous souhaitez mettre vos compétences juridiques au service de projets réels et vous investir activement dans leur réussite.

We are a multicultural and forward-thinking qualiﬁed Trust Services Provider based in Capellen, Luxembourg, with over 140 professionals and actively expanding our business internationally. We provide state-of-the-art on on-boarding, digital identities, strong authentication and security services, and qualiﬁed electronic signatures, all bundled into integrated digital documents & identity management solutions.
As a Trusted Partner, we prioritize building long-lasting relationships with our international clients and stakeholders, based on trust and integrity. We strive to be a Committed Partner, dedicating ourselves to delivering exceptional performance and showing steadfast commitment to make a positive impact. As a Visionary Scout, we are constantly seeking out new opportunities for growth and innovation, always staying ahead of the curve in our industry.

Join us in our mission to drive innovation and co-create a better future!

We are currently looking for a motivated and driven Technical Account Manager (m/f/x) under a permanent contract.

Summary
The Technical Account Manager (TAM) acts as the trust advisor for the customers he is in charge. The TAM ensures that customers have the adequate quality of services and pays attention to a successful technology adoption. He also makes sure that customers are perfectly informed by our products, services and solutions roadmaps, enabling the anticipation of the customers' needs.

Missions of the role

Build, maintain, and be accountable for strong and long-lasting relationship with existing clients
