title: Senior Accountant
description:
Scania is undergoing a transformation from being a leading supplier of trucks, buses, and engines to providing complete and sustainable transport solutions. Together with TRATON and our sister brands MAN, Volkswagen Truck & Bus, and International, we are working to shape the future of mobility with innovative and environmentally conscious solutions.

Our values – customer first, respect, team spirit, responsibility, and elimination of waste – are at the heart of everything we do. Together, we are at the forefront of creating a sustainable future.

Role Summary

Join Global Finance Operations and help secure reliable accounting and reporting for Scania's production and logistics operations. Our Production and Logistics Accounting and Reporting team is responsible for record-to-report activities for 18 units and is supporting the transition from Oracle to SAP S/4HANA.

As Senior Accountant, you will own the accounting and reporting for one Swedish legal entity within Production and Logistics. You will combine hands-on accounting with stakeholder coordination and continuous improvement. You are not expected to know every Scania process from day one, but we expect you to take ownership, build the necessary business knowledge and resolve deviations in a structured way.

Job responsibiities

•        Own the monthly, quarterly and annual accounting close and reporting for the designated Swedish legal entity, ensuring complete, accurate and timely reporting.

•        Ensure compliance with IFRS, Group requirements and applicable Swedish statutory accounting requirements, coordinating with Tax specialists on relevant tax matters.

•        Ensure that balance sheet reconciliations, key financial controls and supporting documentation are completed, reviewed and followed up, with differences and control exceptions resolved on time.

•        Secure accounting quality across general accounting and reporting, fixed assets, overhead and cost-center accounting, and project accounting, in cooperation with the responsible process teams.

•        Act as the primary accounting contact for the legal entity, working with auditors, Group Reporting, Tax specialists and relevant finance and business control teams.

•        Coordinate accounting interfaces, including payroll and personnel-related postings, and ensure that exceptional transactions follow established approval and control procedures.

•        Analyze accounting deviations, identify root causes and coordinate corrective actions and process improvements with the responsible process owners.

•        Represent accounting and legal-entity requirements in the Oracle-to-SAP S/4HANA transformation, including testing, data validation, cutover and process implementation.

•        Share accounting knowledge and provide technical guidance to colleagues and process teams when required.



Who You Are

You demonstrate strong accounting knowledge, ownership and sound judgment. You have substantial experience with end-to-end accounting and reporting for a Swedish legal entity, including closing, balance sheet control, statutory reporting and coordination with tax and audit specialists. You understand the business impact of accounting issues, communicate them clearly and proactively raise risks and deviations. You share knowledge and challenge unclear ways of working respectfully.

You Need to Bring

•        A university degree in accounting or finance, or an equivalent professional qualification.

•        At least seven years of relevant experience in accounting and financial reporting, including responsibility for a Swedish legal entity.

•        Strong knowledge of Swedish GAAP and statutory requirements, together with practical experience of IFRS and group reporting.

•        Proven experience of independently coordinating monthly, quarterly and annual closing, including balance sheet reconciliations, statutory reporting and audit support.

•        Hands-on experience with a major ERP system, such as Oracle or SAP.

•        Clear and confident communication skills in English, both written and spoken.

We Also Value That You

•        Communicate accounting matters clearly and build effective working relationships across functions.

•        Work calmly and methodically under time pressure, prioritizing issues according to risk, materiality and deadlines.

•        Take a constructive and service-minded approach while safeguarding accounting quality and compliance.

•        Identify root causes, solve problems and turn practical improvements into more efficient and standardized ways of working.

•        Is curiosity about how AI and digital tools can support accounting, reporting and analysis.

It Is an Advantage If You Have

•        Experience with SAP S/4HANA implementation, testing or transformation.

•        Experience using data, automation or AI tools to improve accounting and reporting.



This Is Us

You will join a team of 10 skilled and experienced colleagues who value collaboration, knowledge sharing and continuous improvement.

At Scania, we believe embracing AI is essential for our continued growth and innovation. We are committed to providing our employees with the latest AI tools and fostering an environment where AI skills are encouraged. You don't need prior experience with AI - but we expect curiosity, openness and a positive attitude toward learning and applying AI in your role.

We work closely with local finance departments, finance managers, business control teams, Global Process Owners, Subject Matter Experts and other specialists across Global Finance Operations.

Together, we support each other, challenge existing ways of working and contribute to Scania's finance transformation.





Scania Offers

We offer a dynamic and engaging workplace where collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement are part of everyday life. You will be part of a strong team environment that encourages knowledge sharing and close cooperation across functions.

With a structured development plan and a wide range of training opportunities, Scania supports your professional growth both locally and internationally.

Benefits include access to our health center in Gröndal or a wellness allowance, result bonus, flexible working hours, and company car leasing. Scania also arranges events for employees and their families, and for those living in Stockholm, convenient commuting is supported through direct Scania Job express buses to Södertälje.



Application

We look forward to receiving your application, consisting of your CV and kindly ask you not to share a cover letter to ensure an efficient and unbiased recruitment process for all parties.



Apply as soon as possible, no later than 2026-10-08. Screening will take place on an ongoing basis during the application period. Logical and personality tests may be used as part of the selection process, and a background check may be required for this role.



If you have questions or would like more information, please contact:

Hiring Manager: claes.back.ahlstrom@scania.com

We look forward to your application!

title: French-speaking babysitter (Part-Time) – Stockholm
description:
Looking for a fun and meaningful job? Do you love working with children and speaking French?

We are looking for enthusiastic, responsible, and creative French-speaking babysitters to join our team in Stockholm.

At Upgrades, we offer a unique concept where pedagogy and development of the French language are at the heart of the babysitting.

We currently have assignments available throughout Stockholm, including Central Stockholm, Lidingö, Täby, and several other areas.

Our assignments

Upgrades offers French language focused childcare in several different forms, ranging from occasional help to spending many hours with the family and becoming like an additional family member.

Based on your preference regarding age and number of children, we match you with a suitable family.

Please note that this is a part-time position and you are therefore expected to have another primary occupation.

If employed as a babysitter at Upgrades, you will be required to provide a criminal record extract.

What You'll Do

The work includes picking up the child or children from preschool or school, basic food preparation, play and activities while maintaining a focus on French language development.

Each session is a minimum of 2.5 hours and you can combine several assignments to increase your total working hours per week.

Some of our assignments require a clean driving licence, so please state this in your application.

Your profile

As a babysitter at Upgrades, you are warm, responsible, and genuinely enjoy working with children. You are playful, dedicated, and proactive, with a natural ability to take initiative. You also bring creative ideas for incorporating French into play and everyday interactions, supporting children’s language development in a natural way.

Requirements

    Native-level or full professional proficiency in French
    Excellent sense of responsibility and child safety
    Strong social and interpersonal skills
    Genuinely interested in childcare and pedagogy
    Positive, dedicated, flexible, and proactive, with a natural ability to take initiative
    Swedish and/or English are not required, but are considered an advantage.

About Upgrades

Upgrades offers tailored language lessons, language camps and language-focused childcare. We combine standard babysitting with a strong focus on language development. Visit our website to learn more: www.upgrades.se

We recruit on a regular basis. Note: The position may therefore be filled before the application deadline.

Submit your resume and cover letter to work@upgrades.se

title: Experienced Software Developer
description:
Build secure, scalable software as a consultant across defense, automotive, and telecom. Whether your strength is .NET, C++, applications, or Azure, we’d like to hear from you.

Your assignments will vary in technology, scope, and working setup. Depending on the project, you may work at a client’s site, from a Knowit office, or remotely. The solutions range from consumer products to complex industrial systems, giving you opportunities to apply your experience across different technical domains.

You might build scalable backend services in C# and .NET, develop applications, work with cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure, or solve challenges closer to industrial systems. Some assignments involve environments with high security requirements, including the defense industry.

Collaboration and knowledge sharing are central to the role. You will work alongside colleagues and clients, take responsibility for your delivery, and contribute ideas throughout the development process. As your interests and expertise evolve, you can explore new technologies and develop in a direction that makes sense for you.

To succeed in this role, we believe you have:

You are an experienced software developer with expertise in one or more of the following areas:

    

Software development in C# and .NET.

    

Development in C++.

    

Backend or application development.

    

Cloud platforms, preferably Azure and the Microsoft ecosystem.

    

Testing at the unit, integration, or system level.

    

Development in environments with high security requirements, such as the defense industry.

We do not expect you to match every item. What matters is that you can contribute solid development experience, enjoy working with others, and take responsibility for your work. Curiosity and a willingness to keep learning will help you thrive as technologies, assignments, and customer needs evolve.

What can you expect from us?

Professional development is part of everyday work. In addition to courses and formal training, you will build knowledge through collaboration, workshops, seminars, and conversations with colleagues from different technical backgrounds.

Close dialogue with your manager helps shape assignments that support your experience, interests, and continued growth. You will have room to explore new technologies, share ideas, and influence how we work.

You will join an inclusive workplace that values openness, community, and continuous improvement. We also recognize the importance of a healthy balance between work and personal life. title: Data Protection Specialist
description:
Every day, our work supports people who rely on our products and services to move forward with confidence.

As we build more direct and meaningful ways to engage with patients and consumers - through patient support programs, digital platforms, marketing activities and CRM solutions - protecting their privacy is not just a legal requirement. It is part of the trust we earn, and the value we create.

We are looking for an experienced Data Protection Specialist to join our Global Privacy & Compliance Team and help shape privacy practices that enable responsible, scalable patient and consumer engagement across our markets. In this role, you will help embed privacy into new and evolving initiatives, making it easier for teams to innovate while keeping patients’ and consumers’ rights, expectations and trust at the centre of what we do.

What you will do

    Provide practical legal advice on data protection and privacy, including GDPR and local legislation across our markets
    Advise on privacy requirements throughout the lifecycle of patient and consumer programs across multiple countries
    Draft and review privacy notices, consent language and data processing agreements, and advise on consent and preference management across the data lifecycle
    Develop proportionate privacy policies, procedures and governance, working with local experts and stakeholders to support a consistent global direction
    Monitor regulatory developments and advise on cross-border processing and international data transfers
    Contribute to broader priorities of the Global Privacy & Compliance Team, including relevant training and awareness activities

What do you need to be successful?

Must-have

    A law degree and at least 5 years of relevant legal experience, including substantial work with privacy and data protection
    Strong knowledge of GDPR and related European privacy requirements
    Experience advising on privacy and data protection matters involving direct engagement with patients, consumers or customers
    Excellent communication skills and confidence working with stakeholders across functions and markets
    Full professional proficiency in English
    A practical, self-motivated and independent working style, with the ability to create structure and move things forward in an evolving environment

Nice-to-have

    Experience in medical devices, healthcare, life sciences, pharmaceuticals or another regulated industry
    Experience supporting patient engagement, marketing, CRM, consent management or other direct-to-consumer initiatives, preferably across multiple countries
    Experience applying privacy by design to digital products or platforms; familiarity with website tracking technologies, Salesforce, advertising platforms or marketing technology is an advantage

Working model and location

This role is open to candidates located in Denmark or Sweden. We are open to a fully remote working setup, with the possibility of a hybrid model for candidates based near our offices in Copenhagen or Stockholm.

What we offer

We want you to feel supported, trusted and able to do your best work, wherever you are based.

As part of our team, you can expect a competitive local benefits package, which may include:

    Time to recharge - paid vacation and additional leave arrangements in line with local market practices.
    Financial and health-related benefits - including pension arrangements and relevant wellbeing or healthcare-related support, depending on your location.
    Everyday support and perks - such as access to benefit platforms, employee discounts, work equipment and other locally relevant initiatives.
    A flexible, international work environment - collaboration with colleagues across markets, with a working model designed to support both focus and connection.

Join us in our mission to improve people’s mobility so they can live their Life Without Limitations!

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Stories have the power to make the ordinary extraordinary. They help us think bigger, see beyond ourselves, and deepen our connection with others.

As one of the world’s leading audiobook and e-book streaming platforms, Storytel brings unlimited listening to millions of users across 25 markets. We’re at the forefront of digital storytelling, driven by a vision to make the world a more empathetic and creative place.

Ready for your next chapter? We are now on the lookout for a platform-focused Senior Data Engineer to join the team in Stockholm.

About the Team

The Data Engineering team is responsible for empowering Storytel with data. We drive the full data lifecycle, from ingestion to delivery, and help ensure that the rest of the business have the data, tools and engineering collaboration needed to help make informed data-driven decisions. As a team, we provide cross-functional competencies in data engineering as well as analytics engineering to the rest of Storytel.

Some of the tech stack and tools we work with are dbt (SQL), Looker, BigQuery, Python, Airflow, Terraform, CI/CD, Github, Airbyte as well as other products included within the Google Cloud Platform. Moreover, we like to keep our skills up to date by frequently engaging lab days.

About the Role

As a Data Engineer, your main responsibility will be to enable the team and the rest of the organization with a data platform and the tools that power data at Storytel. You will have the opportunity to work in a dynamic environment with plenty of opportunities to experiment with new technologies and solutions. Our team is highly collaborative and works in a cross-functional organizational landscape with the following:

Example of responsibilities

    Build core infrastructure: Contribute to building a large-scale, highly performant self-service data platform using cutting-edge technologies
    Innovate and improve: Drive internal tooling and process development to continuously increase data quality and constantly improve the engineering experience.
    Excellence in data management: Continuously improve on building capabilities for effective data utilization across Storytel.
    Collaboration: Collaborate with other engineers, data analysts, data scientists, and decision-makers to understand needs and build self-service.

About you

To be a fit for our team, we believe that you:

    Have a few years of hands-on experience in delivering data products and know the value of accurate consistent data infrastructure.
    Have experience in delivering infrastructure using Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, Github (Github actions), and maintaining data orchestration tools such as Airflow, dbt, Airbyte.
    Have experience with cloud infrastructure (Azure, AWS, or GCP) and data warehousing (preferably BigQuery).
    Have a good understanding of data access, storage, and optimization.
    Are able to break down and explain complicated technical solutions independent of stakeholders.
    Thrive in an environment focusing on innovation and collaboration and continuously work on personal development.

Bonus qualifications:

    Experience with streaming data ingestion.
    Expertise in developing CI/CD pipelines tailored for data infrastructure.

Join a world of stories

At Storytel, we’re a team of creative story lovers who thrive on collaboration and new ideas. Our workplace is friendly, dynamic, and full of opportunities to experiment and make an impact. We believe in trust, flat hierarchies, and empowering you to grow with us.

title: Auditor with experience of Financial Sector
description:
Do you want to be part of a team that is developing tomorrow's businesses and organizations? At PwC, we strive to be proactive advisors that really make a difference in society. As an employee in audit, you work to identify risks, solve complex audit questions, analyze data and draw conclusions about the information presented by our customers. The digital development and increased demands for transparency contribute to the fact that the audit of the future will require more multifaceted competence than before, which also provides more opportunities for specialization. At PwC, working as an auditor can look very different and this means that you can create your own career path. You can choose to become a customer manager or immerse yourself in a specialist area such as data analysis, sustainability reporting, internal control or invest in a career as a leader.

Read more about our service areas within auditing

Who are you?

    2+ years of experience working with auditing.
    Experience from Big4 and preferably PwC
    Experience working with AI and generative AI Tools
    Fluent in English, both spoken and written.

We attach great importance to your personal qualities and therefore believe that you:

    Is service oriented and motivated by delivering results and meeting our customers' expectations.
    Is adaptable, can read situations and adapt both behavior and communication in building qualitative and diversified relationships.
    Acts with integrity by being straightforward and honest in communication and is easy to get others on board with
    Has good analytical skills and is solution-oriented. You enjoy learning new things and are curious about digitization and new technology to be able to solve customers' needs.
    Has interpersonal skills and the ability to create relationships and networks. These skills are needed to work well with our clients, but are of course also important for collaboration within our team.
    Is structured, efficient and organized.

Recruitment Process

We will review applications continuously, and the position may be filled earlier than the application deadline.

    CV

When meeting with HR, you will have a competency-based interview where we examine the personality test you completed before the interview. During the interview with the business, you will have the opportunity to meet with the relevant team to discuss the role. We call for interviews continuously, and we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

For questions about the job or the recruitment process, contact the responsible recruiter below.

At PwC, we help our clients build trust and transform their businesses to enhance competitiveness. We are leaders in tax, audit, and advisory services and are part of a global network with 364,000 employees in 136 countries. PwC Sweden is an independent legal entity with over 3,000 employees across the country. Want to know more about PwC? Visit us at pwc.se or on LinkedIn.

title: Developer
description:

title: HR Business Analyst to automotive company
description:
Do you excel at bridging the gap between business needs, solution design, and technical implementation? Are you an analytical thinker who thrives in complex transformation projects involving both global and local stakeholders? If so, this might be your next exciting opportunity!

About the position

Your daily tasks

In this assignment, you will contribute to the design, alignment, and implementation of project-driven changes within a transformation project. You will work closely with cross-functional stakeholders throughout the transformation journey:

    Gather, document, maintain, and update business requirements for the new HR solution
    Translate requirements into clear process designs, future-state processes, and workflows
    Support requirements mapping, process analysis, impact assessments, and testing activities
    Ensure requirements and process documentation is accurate, accessible, structured, and kept up to date
    Collaborate with project and change teams to support implementation readiness, rollout, and stabilization
    Support the development and update of user and administrator guides
    Support alignment of business requirements across stakeholder groups and help embed new ways of working for sustainable adoption

Your characteristics

To succeed in this role, you are a collaborative and people-oriented professional who builds trust and creates alignment across different teams. You have a structured and proactive approach, allowing you to manage complexity while maintaining progress through clear coordination.

You are analytical and questioning in your approach—able to distinguish between legal requirements, genuine business needs, and historical ways of working. You actively identify gaps, contradictions, and duplicate requirements to keep the project moving forward. Furthermore, you are adaptable and resilient when priorities shift in a fast-moving project environment. Please apply today!

Qualifications:

Education & Technical Skills

    Relevant academic education or equivalent professional experience
    Experience working with business requirements and/or process development
    Understanding of HR / People & Culture processes from a business perspective
    Experience working with HR systems

title: Head Chef
description:
Join Trattoria Giorgio's!

About Trattoria Giorgio's

Inspired by Italy’s neighbourhood trattorias, Giorgio’s is all about genuine hospitality, comforting food and a strong sense of community. It’s a warm, characterful place where people work closely, bring their personality to every service and make guests feel like regulars from day one.

Part of Urban Italian Group

The Role

This is a role for someone who enjoys structure, ownership and the pace of a high-volume restaurant.

What you'll be doing

    

Leading the kitchen team through prep, service and daily operations.

You'll thrive in this role if you

    

Has strong experience as a Head Chef, Sous Chef or senior kitchen leader.

    

Is confident leading a busy, high-volume kitchen.

    

Understands food cost, stock control, ordering and kitchen profitability.

    

Can train, coach and motivate a team with clear standards.

Takes pride in consistency, cleanliness and operational discipline.

    

Believes great kitchens are built through teamwork, ownership and respect.

Our culture and values

We believe we work with people, not food. Guided by our values of Trust, Inclusion, Passion and Entrepreneurship, we’re committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels welcome, valued and empowered to grow.

International career opportunities.

    

Referral bonus scheme.

title: Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH Alterspsychiatrie 60-80% für die Region Aarau gesucht
description:
- Eine etablierte Institution in der Region Aarau sucht Verstärkung: Sie als Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH, Schwerpunkt Alterspsychiatrie.

### Kurz zusammengefasst: Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH in Aarau

**Position:** Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH

**Fachbereich:** Alterspsychiatrie

**Pensum:** 60–80 %

**Anstellung:** Feste Stelle

**Start:** Nach Vereinbarung

**Arbeitsort:** Region Aarau

**Arbeitgeber:** Den Namen nennen wir Ihnen gerne im Gespräch

Kurz gesagt: Der Rahmen stimmt. Zudem lernen Sie nun den Arbeitsort besser kennen, denn genau darum geht es als Nächstes.

Aarau, die Hauptstadt des Kantons Aargau, liegt zentral in der Schweiz und ist hervorragend mit Bahn und Auto erreichbar. Die Stadt bietet Ihnen eine ausgezeichnete Verkehrsanbindung zu den großen Wirtschaftszentren Zürich und Basel. Als Arbeitsort punktet Aarau mit einer florierenden Wirtschaft, attraktiven Unternehmen und einem hohen Lebensstandard bei gleichzeitig moderaten Lebenshaltungskosten.

### Ihr Aufgabengebiet als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Alterspsychiatrie in Aarau

- Sie tragen dabei die Verantwortung über den ganzen Pflegeprozess, von der Erhebung bis zur Auswertung
- Zudem: Durchführung ärztlicher Verordnungen sowie sichere Abgabe der Medikamente
- Zudem überwachen Sie die Vitalzeichen, denn Sie erkennen früh, wenn sich etwas ändert
- Darüber hinaus leiten Sie FaGe, Pflegeassistenz sowie Lernende fachlich an
- Ausserdem lückenlose Pflegedokumentation im elektronischen System
- Zusammenarbeit mit Ärzteschaft, Therapien sowie Angehörigen auf Augenhöhe

### Das setzen wir für diese Stelle voraus

- Zuerst das Fachliche: die Ausbildung als dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder FH
- Bei ausländischem Diplom: SRK-Anerkennung zwingend erforderlich
- Zudem Erfahrung in der Langzeitpflege, Akutpflege oder Reha
- Vor allem Verantwortung, Empathie sowie eine belastbare, ruhige Art
- Dazu sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (mind. B2)

### Ihr Arbeitsumfeld: Alterspsychiatrie

Sie arbeiten in einem psychiatrischen Umfeld. Beziehung ist hier das wichtigste Werkzeug: Sie begleiten Menschen in Krisen, geben Halt und arbeiten mit klaren Strukturen. Zudem sind Deeskalation und der geschulte Blick für Veränderungen Teil Ihres Alltags – ein Fachbereich, der viel gibt.

Kurz gesagt: Als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Alterspsychiatrie in Aarau verbinden Sie Fachlichkeit mit einem Umfeld, das zu Ihnen passt. Darum lohnt sich diese Stelle doppelt.

### Der Beruf im Detail: Was macht eine diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH?

Diplomierte Pflegefachpersonen HF/FH tragen die fachliche Verantwortung im gesamten Pflegeprozess. Sie erheben den Pflegebedarf, danach planen Sie die Massnahmen und werten die Ergebnisse aus. Zudem steuern Sie die Abgabe der Medikamente, überwachen Vitalzeichen und erkennen Veränderungen früh. Somit entsteht Pflegequalität, die ankommt.

Der Weg in diesen Beruf führt über die höhere Fachschule (HF) oder das Bachelorstudium Pflege (FH). Ausländische Diplome brauchen dafür eine [Anerkennung durch das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK)](https://www.redcross.ch/de/srk-anerkennung). Ausserdem stehen erfahrenen Fachpersonen viele Wege offen: ein Nachdiplomstudium (NDS), die Rolle als Berufsbildnerin oder die Teamleitung.

Der Arbeitsmarkt für Fachpersonen in der Alterspsychiatrie rund um Aarau ist ausgesprochen dynamisch, da die demografische Entwicklung zu einer stark wachsenden Nachfrage nach spezialisierten Pflegekräften führt. Sie profitieren als Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH von hervorragenden Chancen, attraktiven Positionen in einem 60-80%-Pensum zu finden, da viele Institutionen flexible Lösungen anbieten. iPersonal unterstützt Sie durch ihr großes Netzwerk von etablierten Arbeitgebern in der Region und ermöglicht Ihnen als Vermittler einen reibungslosen Einstieg in eine erfüllende Fachposition mit passenden Rahmenbedingungen.

### Ihre Vorteile mit MediPersonal in der Region Aarau

- Kostenlose Weiterbildungen über [Temptraining](https://temptraining.ch) – somit bekommt Ihre Karriere Rückenwind
- Persönliche Begleitung von der Bewerbung bis zum ersten Arbeitstag
- Dazu schnelle sowie ehrliche Antworten – meist innerhalb von 24 Stunden
- Faire Verträge nach GAV, denn Ihr Lohn soll klar und offen sein
- Zudem eine langfristige Perspektive, denn wir vermitteln Stellen, die wirklich zu Ihrem Leben passen
- Diskretion ist Ehrensache – denn Ihre Bewerbung behandeln wir streng vertraulich

### Häufige Fragen zur Stelle als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Alterspsychiatrie in Aarau

**Welche Ausbildung brauche ich für diese Stelle?**
Dafür benötigen Sie ein Diplom als Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder aber einen Bachelor in Pflege FH. Ausländische Abschlüsse sind mit SRK-Anerkennung ebenso willkommen.

**Ist mein ausländisches Pflegediplom in der Schweiz gültig?**
Ja, sofern das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK) Ihr Diplom anerkannt hat. Ausserdem beraten wir Sie gerne kostenlos zur Anerkennung.

**Wie schnell erhalte ich eine Rückmeldung auf meine Bewerbung?**
Meist hören Sie schon innerhalb von 24 Stunden von uns, denn Ihre Zeit ist uns wichtig. Zudem halten wir Sie danach laufend auf dem neusten Stand.

**Erfahre ich den Namen des Arbeitgebers?**
Ja – sobald wir sprechen, nennen wir Ihnen den Namen der Institution offen. Denn Offenheit gehört bei uns dazu.

Übrigens: Laufend weitere [offene Stellen](https://med-ipersonal.ch/offene-stellen/), Jobs und Stellenangebote in Pflege und Medizin finden Sie auf med-ipersonal.ch – täglich aktualisiert.

### Interessiert? Wir freuen uns auf Sie

- Ihre neue Stelle als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Alterspsychiatrie in Aarau wartet – zudem beraten wir Sie gerne zu weiteren Stellen als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH in Ihrer Region.

Senior Consultant / Assistant Manager – Deal Advisory – Tech CoE

**Location:** Zurich

\* Lead technology M\&A workstreams across due diligence, integration and separation projects, support clients through critical transaction decisions and translate complex technology topics into tangible business value

Successful employees need top\-tier IT infrastructure and excellent mobility\-not only at work but also in their private lives. Engineering Manager
===================







Do you have what it takes to shape a better tomorrow?  
We’re , a multinational company. We move things, people and ideas forward. Working with us means belonging to a passionate, dynamic and innovative team, empowered to make a difference.



We’re looking for team players to provide our customers with high\-quality products, systems and services across a wide range of industries. By joining our team, you’ll have the chance to develop yourself and explore different opportunities within the Company.



For our Motion, Power, Sensing Division site based in Fribourg, we are currently looking for a  



Engineering Manager
===================



In this role, you will be responsible for leading and developing the engineering team dedicated to sensors and mechanical sub\-systems, with a strong focus on mechanical sensor design, micromechanics, product lifecycle management (PLM) implementation, and engineering process excellence.







**Your responsibilities**



• Lead and develop the Sensors Engineering team, including objectives, governance, competency development, talent management, and succession planning.  
• Drive the development of sensor technologies and mechanical sub\-systems from research to product, ensuring delivery against market launch timing, development cost, recurring cost, quality, and technical performance targets.  
• Lead PLM implementation and adoption, including engineering workflows, configuration management, change control, design release, documentation, and team training.  
• Establish and improve engineering processes and standards, ensuring compliance with aerospace \& energy lifecycle processes, and internal procedures  
• Provide technical leadership and cross\-functional support, reviewing solutions, risks, costs, and schedules while supporting , Marketing, Product Management, customers, and senior leadership.  
• Ensure lessons learned from projects are captured and integrated into future development processes  
• Promote standard work and harmonized engineering methods across programs and product lines  
• Lead or support engineering audits, design assurance reviews, and technical maturity assessments  
• Contribute to the strategic technology roadmaps for new sensing \& monitoring technologies



**Your Profile**



• Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, Aerospace Engineering, Microsystems Engineering, Physics, or a related technical discipline…  
• Solid experience implementing or deploying a PLM tool in an engineering or product development environment  
• Significant experience in mechanical product development, ideally involving sensors, conditioners, micromechanics, precision mechanisms, or high\-reliability components  
• Experience implementing engineering processes, standards, or development governance in an industrial environment  
• Experience working in regulated or process\-driven industries such as aerospace or energy  
• Strong project execution mindset with the ability to balance technical performance, cost, quality, and schedule  
• Ability to review and challenge technical solutions, risks, costs, and development plans  
• Strong communication skills with the ability to interact with engineering teams, senior leadership, customers, and cross\-functional stakeholders



If you don’t find yourself in all points, apply anyway, because nobody is perfect and you can learn a lot with us!



Have we sparked your interest?



We look forward getting to know you! Please apply with your complete application documents directly online.

Horticulteur \- paysagiste spécialiste création H/F 80\-100%
==============================================================

Dominée par ses deux châteaux emblématiques, et Tourbillon, la ville de Sion se distingue par son dynamisme, sa convivialité, son climat ensoleillé et son riche patrimoine historique et archéologique. Autant d’atouts qui en font un cadre de vie attractif et de qualité.

La section Parcs et Jardins compte un chef jardinier, deux adjoints et une quarantaine de collaboratrices et collaborateurs permanents, dont des apprentis. Elle est en charge de la création, de l’aménagement et de l’entretien des parcs, espaces verts, rues et places, du fleurissement communal, de la production horticole, de la gestion des aires de jeux, du mobilier urbain et des fontaines, ainsi que de l’entretien de sites emblématiques tels que Montorge, et Tourbillon.

Si vous êtes passionné·e par l’horticulture et souhaitez contribuer à la qualité du cadre de vie de la population sédunoise, rejoignez\-nous !

Afin de renforcer son équipe, la Ville de Sion met au concours le poste d’

**Horticulteur \- paysagiste spécialiste création H/F 80\-100%**

auprès du service Urbanisme et Mobilité, section Parcs et Jardins.

### **Missions principales**

Au sein du secteur création, vous participez activement à la réalisation et au développement des aménagements extérieurs de la Ville de Sion. À ce titre, vous êtes notamment amené·e à :

* créer et rénover des espaces verts et différents aménagements paysagers ;
* réaliser des travaux de maçonnerie liés au métier de paysagiste ;
* effectuer des plantations de végétaux dans les règles de l’art ;
* réaliser des places de jeux, des plans d’eau ainsi que des réseaux d’arrosage automatique ;
* lire et mettre en œuvre des plans d’aménagement ;
* utiliser et entretenir les machines spécifiques aux travaux paysagers, dans le respect des règles de sécurité ;
* participer ponctuellement aux travaux d’entretien des espaces verts publics ;

* contribuer à la formation et à l’accompagnement des apprenti·e·s.


### **Conditions d’engagement**

* justifier de plusieurs années d’expérience dans le domaine de la création et de l’aménagement paysager ;
* posséder de bonnes connaissances des machines utilisées dans le domaine et de leur mécanique ;
* maîtriser la lecture et l’exécution des plans ainsi que le calcul précis des surfaces et des volumes ;
* faire preuve d’autonomie et d’un bon esprit d’équipe, ainsi que de flexibilité, de résistance au stress et d’un sens aigu des responsabilités ;
* aimer transmettre ses connaissances, notamment auprès des apprenti·e·s ;
* être à l’aise avec les outils informatiques usuels ainsi qu’avec l’utilisation d’une tablette ou d’un smartphone pour l’établissement de rapports ;
* être titulaire du permis de conduire pour véhicules automobiles ;
* les permis de machiniste M1/M2 et de cariste R1 constituent un atout.


### **Nous offrons**

* une sélection variée de formations continues ;

* des tarifs préférentiels sur les abonnements des transports publics et PubliBike Velospot, ainsi que des rabais sur l’achat de vélos électriques, dans le cadre du plan de mobilité ;

- Sie tragen dabei die Verantwortung über den ganzen Pflegeprozess, von der Erhebung bis zur Auswertung
- Zudem: Durchführung ärztlicher Verordnungen sowie sichere Abgabe der Medikamente

- Zusammenarbeit mit Ärzteschaft, Therapien sowie Angehörigen auf Augenhöhe

### Ihr Rüstzeug für den erfolgreichen Einstieg

- Zuerst das Fachliche: die Ausbildung als dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder FH
- Bei ausländischem Diplom: SRK-Anerkennung zwingend erforderlich
- Zudem Erfahrung in der Langzeitpflege, Akutpflege oder Reha
- Vor allem Verantwortung, Empathie sowie eine belastbare, ruhige Art

Die Demenzbetreuung arbeitet person-zentriert: Im Mittelpunkt steht der Mensch mit seiner Biografie. Sie gestalten deshalb einen Alltag mit festen Ritualen sowie vertrauten Handgriffen, erkennen nonverbale Signale und begegnen Unruhe mit Ruhe.

### Der Beruf im Detail: Was macht eine diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH?

Als diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH tragen Sie die fachliche Verantwortung über den ganzen Pflegeprozess. Sie erheben den Pflegebedarf, danach planen Sie die Massnahmen und werten die Ergebnisse aus. Zudem steuern Sie die Abgabe der Medikamente, überwachen Vitalzeichen und erkennen Veränderungen früh. Damit sichern Sie Tag für Tag die Qualität der Pflege.

Der Weg in diesen Beruf führt über die höhere Fachschule (HF) oder das Bachelorstudium Pflege (FH). Ausländische Diplome brauchen dafür eine [Anerkennung durch das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK)](https://www.redcross.ch/de/srk-anerkennung). Ausserdem stehen erfahrenen Fachpersonen viele Wege offen: ein Nachdiplomstudium (NDS), die Rolle als Berufsbildnerin oder die Teamleitung.

Der Arbeitsmarkt für diplomierte Pflegefachpersonen in der Langzeitpflege und Demenzbetreuung in der Region Maur ist derzeit äußerst angespannt, da Fachkräfte stark nachgefragt werden und Institutionen zunehmend Schwierigkeiten haben, offene Stellen zu besetzen. ### Ihre Vorteile mit MediPersonal in der Region Maur

- Bezahlte Kurse über [Temptraining](https://temptraining.ch) – denn wir fördern Ihre Karriere aktiv
- Persönliche Begleitung von der Bewerbung bis zum ersten Arbeitstag
- Dazu schnelle sowie ehrliche Antworten – meist innerhalb von 24 Stunden
- Faire Verträge nach GAV, denn Ihr Lohn soll klar und offen sein
- Zudem eine langfristige Perspektive, denn wir vermitteln Stellen, die wirklich zu Ihrem Leben passen
- Diskretion ist Ehrensache – denn Ihre Bewerbung behandeln wir streng vertraulich

### Häufige Fragen zur Stelle als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Langzeitpflege Demenz in Maur

**Welche Ausbildung brauche ich für diese Stelle?**
Dafür benötigen Sie ein Diplom als Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder aber einen Bachelor in Pflege FH. Ausländische Abschlüsse sind mit SRK-Anerkennung ebenso willkommen.

**Ist mein ausländisches Pflegediplom in der Schweiz gültig?**
Ja, sofern das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK) Ihr Diplom anerkannt hat. Ausserdem beraten wir Sie gerne kostenlos zur Anerkennung.

**Wie schnell erhalte ich eine Rückmeldung auf meine Bewerbung?**
Meist hören Sie schon innerhalb von 24 Stunden von uns, denn Ihre Zeit ist uns wichtig. Zudem halten wir Sie danach laufend auf dem neusten Stand.

- Eine etablierte Institution in der Region Thusis sucht Verstärkung: Sie als Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH.

### Ihre Stelle als Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH in Thusis auf einen Blick

**Position:** Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH

**Fachbereich:** Gesundheitswesen

**Pensum:** 100 %

**Anstellung:** Feste Stelle

**Start:** Nach Vereinbarung

**Arbeitsort:** Region Thusis

**Arbeitgeber:** Den Namen nennen wir Ihnen gerne im Gespräch

Kurz gesagt: Der Rahmen stimmt. Zudem lernen Sie nun den Arbeitsort besser kennen, denn genau darum geht es als Nächstes.
Thusis liegt zentral in Graubünden und bietet eine hervorragende Verkehrsanbindung durch die Rhätische Bahn sowie gut ausgebaute Straßenverbindungen. Die malerische Lage im Domleschg mit unmittelbarem Zugang zu beeindruckenden Naturlandschaften macht den Ort für Sie als Arbeitgeber und Arbeitnehmer attraktiv. Dank der stabilen wirtschaftlichen Strukturen und der hohen Lebensqualität entwickelt sich Thusis zunehmend zu einem geschätzten Arbeitsstandort in der Region.

### Ihre Aufgaben als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH in Thusis

- Sie tragen dabei die Verantwortung über den ganzen Pflegeprozess, von der Erhebung bis zur Auswertung

- Zudem: Durchführung ärztlicher Verordnungen sowie sichere Abgabe der Medikamente

- Zudem überwachen Sie die Vitalzeichen, denn Sie erkennen früh, wenn sich etwas ändert

- Darüber hinaus leiten Sie FaGe, Pflegeassistenz sowie Lernende fachlich an

- Ausserdem lückenlose Pflegedokumentation im elektronischen System

- Zusammenarbeit mit Ärzteschaft, Therapien sowie Angehörigen auf Augenhöhe

### Diese Qualifikationen bringen Sie mit

- Zuerst das Fachliche: die Ausbildung als dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder FH

- Bei ausländischem Diplom: SRK-Anerkennung zwingend erforderlich

- Zudem Erfahrung in der Langzeitpflege, Akutpflege oder Reha

- Vor allem Verantwortung, Empathie sowie eine belastbare, ruhige Art

- Dazu sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (mind. B2)

### Ihr Arbeitsumfeld: Ihre neue Wirkungsstätte

Sie arbeiten in einem etablierten Haus der Pflege – mit einem eingespielten Team, klaren Abläufen und echter Wertschätzung. Wichtig für diese Stelle: Führungserfahrung und Weiterbildung in Leadership bzw. Bereitschaft diese zu absolvieren ist wünschenswert. Dabei erwartet Sie ein Umfeld, in dem Fachlichkeit und Menschlichkeit zusammengehören.

Kurz gesagt: Als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH in Thusis verbinden Sie Fachlichkeit mit einem Umfeld, das zu Ihnen passt. Genau solche Stellen vermitteln wir am liebsten.

### Der Beruf im Detail: Was macht eine diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH?

Als diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH tragen Sie die fachliche Verantwortung über den ganzen Pflegeprozess. Sie erheben den Pflegebedarf, danach planen Sie die Massnahmen und werten die Ergebnisse aus. Zudem steuern Sie die Abgabe der Medikamente, überwachen Vitalzeichen und erkennen Veränderungen früh. Damit sichern Sie Tag für Tag die Qualität der Pflege.

Der Weg in diesen Beruf führt über die höhere Fachschule (HF) oder das Bachelorstudium Pflege (FH). Ausländische Diplome brauchen dafür eine [Anerkennung durch das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK)](https://www.redcross.ch/de/srk-anerkennung). Ausserdem stehen erfahrenen Fachpersonen viele Wege offen: ein Nachdiplomstudium (NDS), die Rolle als Berufsbildnerin oder die Teamleitung.
In der Region Thusis besteht für Diplom-Pflegefachpersonen HF/FH eine hohe Nachfrage, da lokale Spitäler und Pflegeheime kontinuierlich Fachkräfte suchen. Sie profitieren von ausgezeichneten Karrierechancen und attraktiven Arbeitsbedingungen in einem wachsenden Gesundheitssektor. iPersonal als spezialisierter Vermittler erleichtert Ihnen den Einstieg durch fundierte Branchenkenntnisse, persönliche Betreuung und direkten Zugang zu verfügbaren Positionen bei renommierten Arbeitgebern in Graubünden.

### Ihre Vorteile mit MediPersonal in der Region Thusis

- Kostenlose Weiterbildungen über [Temptraining](https://temptraining.ch) – denn wir fördern Ihre Karriere aktiv

- Persönliche Begleitung von der Bewerbung bis zum ersten Arbeitstag

- Dazu schnelle sowie ehrliche Antworten – meist innerhalb von 24 Stunden

- Faire Verträge nach GAV, denn Ihr Lohn soll klar und offen sein

- Zudem eine langfristige Perspektive, denn wir vermitteln Stellen, die wirklich zu Ihrem Leben passen

- Und vor allem: Diskretion garantiert – Ihre Bewerbung behandeln wir streng vertraulich

### Häufige Fragen zur Stelle als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH in Thusis

**Welche Ausbildung brauche ich für diese Stelle?**
Dafür benötigen Sie ein Diplom als Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder aber einen Bachelor in Pflege FH. Ausländische Abschlüsse sind mit SRK-Anerkennung ebenso willkommen.

**Ist mein ausländisches Pflegediplom in der Schweiz gültig?**
Ja, sofern das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK) Ihr Diplom anerkannt hat. Ausserdem beraten wir Sie gerne kostenlos zur Anerkennung.

**Wie schnell erhalte ich eine Rückmeldung auf meine Bewerbung?**
In der Regel melden wir uns bereits innerhalb von 24 Stunden bei Ihnen, denn Ihre Zeit ist wertvoll. Zudem halten wir Sie danach laufend auf dem neusten Stand.

**Erfahre ich den Namen des Arbeitgebers?**
Ja, selbstverständlich – denn im persönlichen Gespräch nennen wir Ihnen die Institution gerne. Denn Offenheit gehört bei uns dazu.

Reconnue et incontournable depuis plus de 40 ans, Multi Personnel est une agence spécialisée dans la mise à disposition de personnel administratif et de cadres, temporaire et fixe, dans de nombreux secteurs économiques, tels que la banque, sociétés financières, multinationales, ONG, PME et institutions locales.

Das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz ist die grösste humanitäre Organisation der Schweiz. Das SRK Kanton Bern setzt sich im ganzen Kanton für mehr Menschlichkeit ein. Das SRK Bern führt drei Secondhandläden «la trouvaille» in Bern, Biel und Münsingen. Das Angebot von «la trouvaille» besteht fast ausschliesslich aus gespendeten und gebrauchten Waren. * Selbstständigkeit und geben konstruktives Feedback.

Votre expertise vous permet d'apporter une réelle valeur ajoutée dans les choix techniques et les orientations constructives, tout en garantissant la faisabilité et la cohérence globale des projets.

Vous accompagnez les clients et partenaires tout au long du projet, en leur apportant des conseils techniques pertinents et une vision claire des enjeux.

Vous participez aux séances de coordination et assurez le suivi des travaux afin de garantir la conformité des réalisations aux exigences définies.

L'entreprise se concentre sur l'acquisition et la valorisation de terrains à bâtir afin de développer des projets à fort impact économique, social et environnemental. Sa mission consiste ainsi à créer de la valeur pour ses investisseurs tout en s'engageant activement pour un développement urbain responsable et tourné vers l'avenir. Son ADN repose sur une approche entrepreneuriale et responsable , guidée par l’engagement ainsi que la recherche de valeur durable.

Pour soutenir notre équipe, nous recherchons un\-e


**Chef de projet immobilier**  


Vous jouez un rôle central dans l’identification, l’évaluation et le pilotage des projets de développement immobilier. En collaboration avec la Direction et les différents partenaires, vous analysez les opportunités, évaluez leur faisabilité, leurs risques et leur rentabilité, puis coordonnez leur mise en œuvre.

Attentif à la création de valeur, vous définissez les priorités et optimisez l’allocation des ressources en fonction des enjeux et du potentiel de chaque opération. Votre expertise du marché immobilier vous permet d’anticiper les risques, d’identifier les leviers d’optimisation et de contribuer à la réussite économique des projets et à la croissance durable de l’entreprise.

Vos tâches principales :

* Piloter et coordonner les projets immobiliers de la planification à la réception, ainsi que le suivi des travaux de garantie.

* Coordonner les mandants, mandataires, entreprises et intervenants internes et externes afin de garantir le bon déroulement des opérations.
* Suivre les coûts, délais, qualité et principaux indicateurs des projets, identifier les écarts et mettre en œuvre les mesures correctives nécessaires.

Financial Services Software Engineer
====================================

Senior Software Engineer to modernise financial risk platforms using C\#/.NET, microservices and modern data technologies in Basel.

Financial Services Software Engineer
====================================

### description:

As a **Financial Services Software Engineer**, you will join a Risk IT team of approximately 12–15 engineers and contribute to the modernisation of business\-critical financial risk management systems. The environment is transitioning from a legacy monolithic architecture towards scalable, containerised microservices.

Your responsibilities will include:

* Contribute to the continued development of the **Risk IT microservices stack in C\#**
* Refactor and decompose an existing **.NET Framework** codebase into smaller components for migration to **.NET Core and OpenShift**
* Support the transition towards a **Cloudera\-based Data Lake** platform
* Replace legacy interfaces to Banking IT systems with a **Kafka\-based streaming architecture**
* Work closely with business users and Risk Analysts to gather and refine requirements
* Deliver stable, incremental improvements with a strong focus on testing and software quality
* Participate in rotating business\-hours support to maintain system stability and performance
* Contribute to projects focused on automating risk operations and modernising the application landscape


### About the customer:

Our client is a prestigious international financial institution based in Basel, operating at the heart of the global financial system. The technology environment is international and collaborative, with engineering teams developing critical platforms supporting financial risk management and analysis.

### Requirements:

* Senior\-level software engineering experience
* Professional development experience with an **object\-oriented language such as C\#, Java or C\+\+**, with willingness to work with C\# and codebases
* Previous professional experience within **financial services**, either directly within banking/financial/insurance organisations or through software development services delivered to financial institutions
* Familiarity with at least one financial product domain, such as **fixed income, equities or foreign exchange**
* Strong understanding of **algorithms, data structures and software design patterns**
* Experience with **relational databases**, such as Oracle or SQL Server
* Ability and willingness to collaborate directly with business users to define and refine requirements
* Experience working within **Agile development teams** and iterative delivery environments
* Strong problem\-solving skills and a logical, methodical approach
* Proactive and pragmatic mindset with ownership of delivery and quality
* **Fluent English**
Nice to have

* Experience implementing **financial product pricing**
*
* Microservices architecture and design
* Kafka
* OpenShift
* Data Engineering
* Cloudera / Data Lake environments
* WPF
* Web technologies


### Compensation benefits:

Please note interviews would be conducted via video call (max two rounds), however the role is based 100% in Switzerland. Our client offers:



* The opportunity to work in a diverse and international environment on a long\-term basis
* 50% working from home
* 20 days working remotely from abroad per year
* Modern office in central Basel (50 minutes direct train from Zurich) with subsidised canteen




Are you interested to work in an international environment in one of the most important financial companies worldwide? Then apply now! We look forward to receiving your full application before the deadline on Friday 2 October.

The School is CIS accredited, and caters for 500 students aged 6 \\-18 representing 70 nations. Students prepare for Cambridge IGCSEs and the IB Diploma Programme. The school wishes to appoint, for January 2027, a teacher of Biology. The ideal candidate for this position would be an experienced teacher with a proven track record at achieving excellent results. Experience teaching Biology at IB or A\\-level is necessary as well as having experience of IGCSE Biology, and lower school general science. However, the school is open to all applications from inspirational candidates. The science faculty is a thriving team of eleven full\\-time teachers supported by four dedicated lab technicians. The department is based in a suite of well\\-equipped laboratories located within a chalet\\-style building. A major refurbishment of the science laboratories has been recently completed. In the Discovery programme (Years 7\\-9\\), students are taught science by a single teacher. From Year 10 upwards, the three separate sciences are taught by subject specialists. Year 10 and 11 students are prepared for Cambridge Double Award Coordinated Science (A\\\*\\-G) IGCSE at the end of Year 11, before selecting one or two science subjects in the IB Diploma Programme. description:
Ref 2581357 \| Date: 28 Sept 2026

![Emmenegger Compétences Conseils SA]( )

Institutions autonomes de droit public, les Fonds cantonaux de compensation des allocations familiales et de l’assurance\-maternité jouent un rôle central dans le dispositif genevois des assurances sociales. Placés sous la surveillance du département de la cohésion sociale (DCS), ils contribuent à assurer l’équilibre et la solidarité de ces régimes en centralisant leurs flux financiers, en constituant et gérant leurs réserves et en assurant la gestion de leur fortune. À ce titre, ils veillent notamment au financement des prestations et au placement des avoirs dans une perspective de sécurité, de pérennité et de rendement.



Au cœur d’un écosystème institutionnel complexe, les Fonds entretiennent des relations étroites avec près d’une centaine de caisses de compensation, les partenaires sociaux et les autorités cantonales et fédérales.



Afin de succéder à l’actuelle titulaire qui fera prochainement valoir ses droits à la retraite, les Fonds cantonaux de compensation des allocations familiales et de l’assurance\-maternité recherchent leur prochain·e

**Directeur/Directrice général·e 100%**

Rattaché·e à leurs Conseils d’administration, vous assumez la responsabilité globale des deux Fonds et contribuez à leurs orientations stratégiques. Vous en assurez la représentation auprès de leurs différents partenaires et disposez d’une large autonomie dans l’exercice de votre fonction.







**Vos principales responsabilités**



Dans un environnement en constant mouvement, vous anticipez les évolutions économiques, sociales, réglementaires et financières, en mesurez l'impact et préparez les propositions qui garantissent l'équilibre des régimes à long terme, notamment la fixation des taux de contribution.



Cette vision d'ensemble s'appuie sur une gestion financière rigoureuse : vous soumettez aux Conseils d'administration la stratégie de placement des réserves et en assurez la mise en œuvre, en direct ou avec des partenaires externes selon votre profil. Vous en exercez un suivi attentif, portant sur le reporting, la performance et le niveau de risque.



Vous assurez également le pilotage financier et administratif des Fonds, incluant la gestion des risques et du système de contrôle interne, le suivi budgétaire et comptable ainsi que la conformité aux dispositions législatives des organes d’exécution.



Interlocuteur·trice des Conseils d'administration, des autorités, des caisses de compensation et des acteurs financiers, vous représentez les Fonds et conduisez des dossiers complexes dans le respect des équilibres institutionnels. Vous contribuez en particulier activement, sous la conduite du DCS, à la mise en place des évolutions et nouveaux régimes attendus ces prochaines années (allocation de garde et assurance\-parentalité).



Pour mener à bien ces missions, vous pouvez compter sur une équipe de trois personnes, expérimentée et autonome, à la tête de laquelle vous veillez à maintenir une culture de confiance et de responsabilisation, tout en l'accompagnant dans les évolutions à venir.







**Votre profil**



* Formation supérieure de niveau Master en sciences économiques, droit, gestion ou administration publique, idéalement complétée par une formation en finance ou en assurances sociales.
* Au moins 8 ans d'expérience dans une fonction à forte responsabilité, avec une excellente connaissance des assurances sociales suisses et une bonne compréhension de l'administration publique et de son environnement institutionnel.
* Solides compétences financières, vous permettant de gérer la fortune ou d'en superviser la gestion; une expérience en gestion de fortune constitue un atout.
* Bonne connaissance du tissu économique genevois.
* Capacité à anticiper, décider et agir avec autonomie dans des environnements complexes, avec une posture entrepreneuriale et pragmatique.
* Leadership humain et responsabilisant, allié à du discernement, de la conviction, de l'intégrité et un sens marqué de l'intérêt général.
* Excellentes capacités rédactionnelles en français. L’allemand est un atout.


**Pourquoi rejoindre les Fonds cantonaux de compensation des allocations familiales et de l’assurance\-maternité ?**



* Pour l’impact et l’autonomie. Une véritable fonction de Direction générale, avec une large latitude pour proposer, décider et agir sur des enjeux importants pour le tissu économique et social genevois.
* Pour la richesse de la fonction. Assurances sociales, finance, gouvernance et relations institutionnelles se côtoient dans une structure agile, où vision stratégique et proximité avec les dossiers vont de pair.
* Pour accompagner une nouvelle étape. Reprendre une institution solide et reconnue, en préserver les fondamentaux et contribuer à ses prochaines évolutions.


Si vous souhaitez mettre votre expérience, votre leadership et votre vision au service d’une institution jouant un rôle clé dans le dispositif genevois des assurances sociales, nous nous réjouissons de découvrir votre candidature (CV et lettre de motivation) par l’intermédiaire de notre mandataire, Emmenegger Compétences Conseils SA.



*Nous vous garantissons une parfaite discrétion et un suivi personnalisé.*

Senior Consultant / Assistant Manager – Deal Advisory – Tech CoE
====================================================================

**Discover KPMG – Become part of our team**  

With 300 different auditing and advisory service opportunities, our people can choose the career path that suits them best. Through our competencies in business transformation as well as ESG consulting, we support our clients in today's biggest challenges. We are a purpose\-led and values driven company where your insight can create opportunities for you and contribute to a better future. Do work that matters, supported by a community that values difference and cares about you. Gain learning that'll last you a lifetime and be recognized for the impact you make. Find opportunity everywhere with KPMG.

Senior Consultant / Assistant Manager – Deal Advisory – Tech CoE
====================================================================

**Location:** Zurich  
**Workload:** 100\-100%  
**Start Date:** By agreement  

\* Lead technology M\&A workstreams across due diligence, integration and separation projects, support clients through critical transaction decisions and translate complex technology topics into tangible business value  

\* Assess technology capabilities, operating models, applications, infrastructure, cybersecurity, data and IT cost structures to identify risks and value creation opportunities  

\* Develop and quality\-review technology due diligence reports, highlighting risks, value drivers and implications for deal decisions  

\* Translate technology findings into strategic, operational and financial implications linked to operating model, synergies and deal value  

\* Support the design and execution of technology integration and separation strategies, including Day 1 readiness, TSA planning and target operating models  

\* Coordinate client and cross\-functional teams, manage deliverables and timelines, and present findings to senior stakeholders  

\* Coach junior colleagues and contribute to proposals, methodologies and the continued growth of the technology in M\&A offering  

\* Contribute to business development activities, including proposals, client presentations and thought leadership in Technology M\&A  

**Your contribution to KPMG**

**This is what makes you successful**  

\* Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, Business Informatics, Information systems or a related field  

\* Three to five years of experience in Technology M\&A, technology strategy, IT due diligence, integration, separation or related transaction advisory services  

\* Proven experience independently managing workstreams, engaging senior stakeholders and delivering high\-quality technology due diligence, integration or separation projects  

\* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to connect technology topics to commercial and operational outcomes  

\* Confident project management and communication skills, including working with senior stakeholders and coaching junior colleagues  

\* Advanced and English skills; French or Italian is an advantage  

\* Willingness to travel as required for client engagements

**Unlock Your Potential**  


We offer personalized training programs, a wide range of courses, and tailored career paths to help you fully realize your potential. Our offerings include specialized courses, mentoring programs, continuing education, the People Manager Academy, and much more. We encourage you to develop future\-ready skills through digital learning, external programs, and support for professional qualifications. Surrounded by motivated and open\-minded experts, you can exchange ideas, challenge perspectives, and help shape the future.  




**Mentoring and Networking**  


At KPMG, we support your professional and personal development through personalized mentoring programs and a collaborative culture.  
From programs such as WoMentoring for early\-career professionals to networking opportunities and social events, you will build meaningful relationships with colleagues and clients. We value diverse perspectives and believe they are key to innovation and professional growth.



**Flexible Working**  


With us, you'll find the support and flexibility you need to balance your career and private life. You can benefit from hybrid working models, flexible working hours, the option to work from abroad (up to 10 working days per calendar year), and generous parental leave. You also have the option to purchase additional vacation days.  




**Additional Benefits**  


Successful employees need top\-tier IT infrastructure and excellent mobility\-not only at work but also in their private lives. KPMG covers your mobile phone bill, provides financial support for your mobile device and offers an SBB Half\-Fare Travelcard. Parking spaces are also available at fair prices. Our lunch allowance supports your daily meals, and you benefit from additional discounts across various areas.



**Generous Parental Leave**  


We offer generous parental leave: 18 weeks of maternity leave and 4 weeks of paternity leave, which can be taken within the first year after the birth or adoption of your child. Fathers may also apply for up to two additional months of unpaid leave.  
To further support families, we offer places in holiday camps for children aged 6 to 15 during school holidays in cooperation with MS Sports. Additional support services are available through our Parents Circle.



**Inspired by Innovation**  


At KPMG, you'll work with highly qualified, ambitious experts. In our inspiring environment, clear thinking and strong perspectives matter more than hierarchies\-because good ideas always come first. We support you with cutting\-edge tools and state\-of\-the\-art AI technologies, enabling you to actively participate in and shape technological progress in your daily work.



**An inclusive culture**  


Our commitment to Diversity, Equity \& Inclusion is reflected in our policies and practices. Become part of a culture that celebrates individuality. In our various communities (KNOW, KNOW , Pride, and Internationals at KPMG), you can connect with like\-minded colleagues.  




**Health \& Wellbeing**  


We promote employee wellbeing with a strong focus on mental health. Our offerings range from practical self\-care webinars to leadership training. In addition, we provide discounts on numerous fitness programs and sports activities\-ideal for integrating movement into your workday.



**Pension Fund**  


We offer above\-average benefits to help you build a solid retirement plan.



**Our Commitment**  


Quality and integrity are essential at KPMG to build trust and drive change. We are aware of the broader impact of our actions and provide trusted services with a consistent focus on ESG (Environmental, Social, Governance). In addition, we are actively committed to social responsibility by supporting volunteer work and promoting charitable projects through the KPMG Foundation.

Head of Controlling \& Risk \- Director
=======================================







At Swissquote, we're all in.  

All in to shake things up. All in to build the bank people actually want to use. All in to make finance less boring — and a lot more powerful.



We're Switzerland's leading digital bank — 1,500\+ people across Europe, the Middle East and , building real financial solutions for over a million clients worldwide. Growing fast creates room. Room to try things, own things, and grow at a pace most places can't offer. Whether you like the spotlight or prefer to just put your head down and do great work, there's space for both here.



We've ditched the dress code — but never the chance to celebrate. Big win or small, we make it count. The kind of place where the atmosphere takes care of itself.



As an equal opportunity employer, we welcome candidates from all backgrounds, experiences and perspectives to join our team and contribute to our shared success.



Feeling it? It's a good start. Apply.



Head of Controlling \& Risk \- Director
=======================================



The Head Controlling \& Risk leads the Controlling \& Risk department and oversees a multidisciplinary team of approximately 20 employees organised across specialised risks The role is responsible for ensuring that credit, market, liquidity, operational and related regulatory risks are identified, monitored, challenged and reported across the Group in line with the risk appetite defined by the Board of Directors.



The role also oversees the Group's internal control framework, ensuring that key controls, governance standards and related documentation remain effective, consistent and appropriately monitored.



**Key Responsibilities**



*       **Leadership and department management:** define the department's priorities and operating model; lead, coach and develop managers and teams; ensure effective resource allocation and continuous upskilling.



*       **Risk governance and reporting:** produce and present clear reports for the Risk Committee, Executive Management and the Board of Directors; ensure adequate escalation of material risk developments, incidents, KRIs and remediation actions.



*       **Risk framework ownership:** maintain and continuously improve the Group risk management and internal control frameworks, including policies, methodologies, risk appetite monitoring, risk taxonomy, controls and reporting standards; draft, review and update risk policies, procedures and governance documents; support the development of structured approached to assess risk culture, control effectiveness and internal control maturity



The Head Controlling \& Risk provides strategic direction and effective challenge across the following areas, acting as the senior point of contact for C\&R teams, other internal stakeholders, governance bodies and regulators on Controlling \& Risk matters:



*       **Credit, market and liquidity risks \- own investments:** oversee concentration analysis, limit monitoring, stress testing, RWA, capital \& liquidity planning and related risk indicators.



*       **Credit and market risks \- client activities:** oversee the monitoring of clients active in ETD trading, lending and eFX trading, including trading conditions, margin parameters, daily margin call analysis, stress testing and market watch.



*       **Operational risk management:** oversee the identification, assessment, monitoring and reporting of operational risks, excluding dedicated IT and AML topics where separate specialised functions exist; coordinate the RCSA framework, KRIs, incidents and action management monitoring.



*       **Reconciliation activities:** supervise the reconciliation of cash, securities and cryptocurrencies with external counterparties and custodians, ensuring timely escalation and remediation of discrepancies.



*       **Consolidated supervision:** contribute to Group\-level oversight by ensuring consistent risk standards, reporting and escalation across relevant entities and activities.



*       **Regulatory relations:** liaise with FINMA, SIX and other relevant stakeholders on Controlling \& Risk topics, and oversee alignment with applicable regulatory requirements.



*       **Projects, change and new business initiatives:** contribute to New Business Initiative risk analyses, process improvements, automation initiatives and risk\-related transformation projects, including the development of dashboards, maturity assessments and monitoring frameworks supporting continuous improvement of risk governance and internal controls.

*  **In\-scope products and activities:** mainstream securities, including bonds, equities, structured products and precious metals; exchange\-traded derivatives; cryptocurrencies and digital assets; eFX and interbank FX products, including CFDs on multiple underlyings, spot and forward FX.

  **Qualifications** *      Master's degree in a relevant field; a recognised professional qualification in risk, internal controls, audit or finance (e.g. FRM, PRM, CIA, CRMA, CISA or CFA) is strongly preferred.



*      10\+ years of experience in a leadership position in banking, financial services, risk management or a related field, including substantial leadership experience, ideally within a regulated and international financial institution.



*      Proven experience with responsibility for multiple risk disciplines and/or multidisciplinary teams, including exposure to risk governance, internal control frameworks and organisational or control maturity initiatives.



*      Strong strategic leadership and experience managing multidisciplinary expert teams.



*      Broad expertise in credit, market, liquidity and operational risk within a banking environment.



*      Solid knowledge of Swiss banking regulation, FINMA expectations and Basel standards, ideally within a Category 3 bank.



*      Strong strategic thinking, business acumen and judgement.



*      Pragmatic and solutions\-oriented, with the ability to balance risk, business growth and operational efficiency.



*      Strong communication, presentation and writing skills, including risk reports, policies and Board\-level materials



*      Confident constructive challenger, with high integrity, independence and credibility.



*      Technology\-minded, with a strong interest in digitalisation, data and AI.



*      Additional assets:Understanding of ICT, cyber and data\-security with GRC platforms, RCSA, KRI and incident management risk and stress\-testing science, AI and automation applied to risk monitoring and reporting.

- **Moderne Arbeitsumgebung:** Erstklassig ausgestattete Häuser, strukturierte Einarbeitung und ein wertschätzendes, kollegiales Team.
- **Weiterbildung:** Großzügige Budgets und Freistellungen für deine berufliche Entwicklung.

Deine Aufgaben:

- Empathische und fachgerechte Grund- und Behandlungspflege in deinem Fachbereich.
- Planung, Durchführung und digitale Dokumentation der Pflegeprozesse.
- Konstruktive Zusammenarbeit im interdisziplinären Team aus Ärzten, Therapeuten und Pflegekräften.

Das bringst du mit:

- Freude am Beruf, hohe Fachkompetenz und Lust auf eine neue Herausforderung in den Schweizer Alpen.
- Eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Gesundheits- und Krankenpfleger, Krankenschwester oder Pflegefachkraft (m/w/d).
- Zuverlässigkeit, Teamgeist und Bereitschaft zum Wohnortwechsel in die Schweiz.

- **Attraktives Schweizer Gehalt:** Profitiere von sehr guten Verdienstmöglichkeiten und erstklassigen Sozialleistungen.

The Role

We are looking for an experienced Senior Security Engineer with strong expertise in Microsoft Security, Identity and/or Compliance and AI-enabled Modern Workplace or Cloud Services. The successful candidate will design, implement and deliver enterprise-scale security transformations across Microsoft 365, Azure and Microsoft Security technologies, helping customers strengthen their security posture while enabling productivity and innovation.

Key Responsibilities

Security & Identity

- Design and implement enterprise security architectures aligned with Zero Trust principles.
- Lead customer engagements around Identity & Access Management, Identity Governance and Privileged Access Management.
- Implement and optimize Microsoft Entra ID, Conditional Access, MFA, Passwordless Authentication, Identity Governance, Access Reviews, Lifecycle Workflows and Privileged Identity Management.
- Support hybrid identity transformations involving Active Directory, Entra ID and federated identity providers.

Cloud Security

- Design and deploy security solutions across Azure and Microsoft cloud environments.
- Implement and optimize Microsoft Defender for Cloud capabilities, including workloads such as servers, storage, databases, containers and Kubernetes where relevant.
- Conduct cloud security posture reviews and support customers in improving governance, policy management and secure workload design.
- Threat Protection & SOC Modernization

- Implement and tune Microsoft Sentinel including data onboarding, detection engineering, analytics rules, automation and SOAR use cases.
- Contribute to threat hunting, incident response readiness and security operations process improvement.

Data Security & Compliance

- Design and deploy Microsoft Purview solutions for information protection, sensitivity labels, data classification, DLP, records management and data lifecycle management.
- Support customers in meeting compliance, governance and data protection objectives.
- Translate regulatory and business requirements into practical security and compliance controls.

AI & Security Innovation

- Lead customer discussions around secure AI adoption and responsible use of Microsoft Copilot and Security Copilot.
- Deliver readiness assessments and governance frameworks for Copilot-enabled environments.
- Define controls to protect sensitive data and identities in AI-enabled collaboration and cloud scenarios.

Professional Experience

- Years of experience in enterprise security consulting, engineering or architecture.
- Proven experience delivering Microsoft security, identity, and/or compliance or cloud security projects.
- Experience working directly with enterprise customers and senior stakeholders.
- Strong consulting mindset with the ability to translate business requirements into pragmatic security solutions.
- Structured, self-reliant, solution-oriented working style with strong customer and team orientation.

Preferred Certifications

- SC-100 – Cybersecurity Architect Expert
- SC-300 – Identity and Access Administrator
- SC-200 – Security Operations Analyst
- SC-400 – Information Protection Administrator
