title: Analyste, Développeur ou Développeuse fullstack - 100%
description:
Avec plus de 13'000 collaborateurs et collaboratrices représentant 160 mét  
Analyste, Développeur ou Développeuse fullstack \- 100%  
Avec plus de 13'000 collaborateurs et collaboratrices représentant 160 métiers, les Hôpitaux Universitaires de Genève sont un établissement de référence au niveau national et international. Pour en savoir plus sur notre institution, prenez quelques minutes pour consulter notre rétrospective 2025 en cliquant ici.  
La Direction de la Transformation Numérique et de l’Intelligence Augmentée (DTN\-IA) créée, intègre et gère toutes les applications informatiques d'un des systèmes d'information hospitalier les plus performants afin de soutenir les activités cliniques et logistiques des Hôpitaux Universitaires de Genève. Avec un parc de plus de 12'500 postes, 1'300 serveurs pour plus de 250 applications au service de l'ensemble du personnel, disponible 24h/24h et 7j/7j, la DTN\-IA gère un système d'information RH pour les 13'000 collaboratrices et collaborateurs des HUG et des 7 autres institutions genevoises et un ERP performant pour les processus logistiques et financiers des plus complexes.  
La DTN\-IA crée un dossier patient informatisé à la pointe du secteur et participe au rayonnement des HUG grâce à une richesse fonctionnelle reconnue et des collaborations étroites avec tous les professionnels et professionnelles de santé et leurs directions transverses. Par ailleurs, la DTN\-IA intègre des équipements biomédicaux de pointe et du quotidien ainsi que des applications spécialisées pour tous les plateaux médico\-techniques.  
Le métier de la DTN\-IA est de soutenir les activités quotidiennes et de bâtir le futur d'un hôpital moderne et performant, selon les axes stratégiques de l'institution en s'appuyant sur les meilleures pratiques et les standards les plus exigeants.  
Analyste, Développeur ou Développeuse fullstack \- 100%  
Intégrez et renforcez une équipe composée de 2 développeurs fullstack et un lead développeur, dont la mission est de poursuivre le développement et l’évolution de l’application Greco, le logiciel de gestion de planning et de téléconsultation utilisé par le personnel. Le logiciel est également utilisé par les patients et patientes grâce à l’application Concerto. L’équipe travaille de manière agile en s’inspirant fortement de la méthodologie Scrum tout en s’adaptant aux contraintes liées au milieu hospitalier qui impliquent d’être capable de parfois devoir changer rapidement de tâche pour s’adapter aux priorités.  
Vous participez à la rédaction des cahiers des charges techniques, en traduisant les besoins fonctionnels en spécifications détaillées. À partir des spécifications techniques, vous développez le logiciel, aussi bien sur la partie front\-end que back\-end, en utilisant les technologies de pointe et une architecture microservices. Vous faites évoluer la solution et garantissez sa maintenance, tout en assurant un suivi rigoureux. Concrètement, vous développez en autonomie les fonctionnalités et corrections qui vous sont attribuées.  
Grâce à votre esprit d’équipe, vous collaborez étroitement avec l’équipe pour développer des solutions et des fonctionnalités fiables et évolutives. Vous partagez les meilleures pratiques et adoptez une approche critique et constructive dans une optique d’amélioration continue en faisant preuve d’une forte orientation solution.  
Tout au long du cycle de vie du produit, grâce à votre sens de la communication, vous contribuez au développement du logiciel de manière optimale et structurée, assurant un lien essentiel avec les coordinateurs et coordinatrices greco des différents départements médicaux. Vous adaptez votre langage en fonction de vos interlocuteurs et interlocutrices pour vulgariser les termes techniques, challengez les solutions proposées, et collaborez activement avec les parties prenantes pour trouver les adaptations les plus pertinentes.  
De plus, vous veillez à la mise à jour et à la rédaction de la documentation nécessaire. Vous mettez à profit votre capacité de synthèse et votre pragmatisme pour mener votre mission dans les délais impartis et garantir un résultat de qualité.  
Vous participez activement à l’ensemble des phases d'un projet informatique, de son initialisation à sa finalisation, en vous assurant de produire les livrables attendus à chacune de ces phases. En outre, vous assurez également le support utilisateurs de niveau 3, en relation avec les autres services de la DTN\-IA, tout en assurant une orientation client forte.  
Qualifications  
Vous êtes titulaire d'un Master en informatique ou d'un diplôme jugé équivalent, et vous justifiez d’une expérience d’au moins cinq ans dans une fonction de développement fullstack en contact avec le métier.  
Vous maîtrisez une architecture microservices avec les technologies Java/J2EE avec le Framework Spring, en particulier Spring Boot, Spring Data r2dbc, Spring cloud stream et Spring Security, mais également OAuth2, Hibernate et SQL (Oracle, PostgreSQL). Vous avez effectué de nombreux tests unitaires et d'intégration, avec les outils de test Junit5 et Mockito. Une connaissance de l’architecture microservices orienté évènement avec la solution Kafka constitue un atout important.  
Pour la partie frontend, vous détenez une expertise sur Angular avec la version 20 idéalement.  
Vous savez utiliser les outils de collaboration (GIT, JIRA et Confluence) ainsi que les outils de construction Maven et Docker. Une connaissance approfondie des méthodes agiles, notamment Scrum, constitue un atout.  
Vous faites preuve d’une excellente capacité relationnelle dans les environnements pluridisciplinaires, alliant communication, vulgarisation des termes techniques et écoute active pour garantir la compréhension des besoins.  
Vous savez prendre du recul et tirer parti des retours d'expérience pour progresser. Votre sens de l’initiative est un atout précieux pour le développement de solutions innovantes.  
Vous faites preuve d’organisation, d’un bon sens relationnel et d’autonomie dans la recherche de solutions. Par ailleurs, vous avez démontré votre capacité d’initiative et vous souhaitez relever des défis dans un environnement exigeant et de grande technicité.  
Informations supplémentaires  
Entrée en fonction : à convenir  
Nombre de poste: 1  
Taux d’activité : 100%  
Classe de fonction : 20  
Contrat : Contrat à durée déterminée de 12 mois

Votre dossier de candidature doit comporter une lettre démontrant votre motivation, votre curriculum vitae, les copies des diplômes et attestations requis pour le poste et les 2 derniers certificats de travail.

title: Applied Physicist - ATLAS Muon LS3 Integration and Installation Manager
description:
What you'll do:
As ATLAS Muon LS3 Integration and Installation Manager you will play a key role in the preparation and execution of activities during Long Shutdown 3 (LS3). You will be responsible for ensuring effective coordination across all ATLAS Muon sub-projects. You will closely follow daily work at P1 for Muon upgrade and maintenance projects, monitor progress, and take action to keep Muon activities on schedule. The role requires close collaboration with various ATLAS Muon sub-projects, ATLAS Technical Coordination (TC), and other relevant CERN groups. You will serve as the primary interface between the Muon projects and ATLAS TC, ensuring coherent planning, efficient execution, and comprehensive reporting of all activities.

During Long Shutdown 3 (LS3, 2026-2030), the ATLAS Muon detector will undergo significant upgrades, including the installation of new detector systems and extensive maintenance of existing detector components. As the ATLAS Muon LS3 Integration and Installation Manager, you will play a central role in planning, coordinating, and monitoring these activities.

Your responsibilities:
- Responsible for ensuring effective coordination of installation and integration activities across the Muon projects, tracking progress, identifying risks, and ensuring effective communication among all participating teams.
- Act as the liaison between the various Muon sub-projects and ATLAS TC, providing regular status updates and comprehensive documentation.
- Develop, maintain, and monitor the integrated LS3 schedule for Muon installation, integration, and maintenance activities in close collaboration with ATLAS TC team.
- Coordinate and oversee technical activities on the ATLAS Muon detectors in the UX15 cavern.
- Identify, manage, and resolve interface issues, schedule conflicts, and resource constraints across multiple projects and teams.
- Organise and chair regular ATLAS Muon LS3 coordination meetings, collect status information, and maintain an overview of ongoing and planned activities.
- Support Muon detector teams in coordinating LS3 activities to ensure timely delivery and efficient planning.
- Prepare and maintain comprehensive documentation, progress reports, and activity summaries.

Your profile:
- Proven experience in coordinating activities for large-scale detector systems or comparable complex scientific installations.
- Demonstrated experience in planning and managing work program involving multiple teams and stakeholders.
- Demonstrated experience coordinating complex technical projects, managing competing priorities, and resolving planning, scheduling, and resource constraints in a multidisciplinary environment.
- Experience with safety systems and safety-related technical infrastructure.
- Familiarity with installation, integration, commissioning, or maintenance activities in large scientific facilities is considered an asset.
- PhD or equivalent relevant experience in the field of Physics or a related field.

Your skills:
- Assembly and integration of detectors.
- Knowledge and application of gas based particle detection technologies.
- Testing and validation of detector, accelerator and beam line components.
- Assembly and integration of infrastructure for detectors or experimental facilities.
- Organisation, planning and control.
- Team management.
- Uses openness and honesty to interact constructively with others.
- Adapts quickly and resourcefully to shifting priorities and requirements.
- Produces workable and timely solutions that meet requirements.
- Takes initiative beyond regular tasks and makes things happen.
- Spoken and written English, with a commitment to learn French.

Employment conditions:
- Work in Radiation Areas.
- Interventions in underground installations.
- A valid driving licence.
- Work during nights, Sundays and official holidays, when required by the needs of the Organization.

Medical hazard:
- Exposure to electromagnetic fields under certain conditions.
- Given the occupational health risks associated with this position, the selected candidate must obtain medical clearance before a contract offer is confirmed.

Ideal start date: 01/01/2027
Contract duration (in months): 54
Grade range: 6

Job flexibility: Fully Onsite
Team supervision

Aufgabenbereich:

Hauptverantwortlichkeiten der Rolle:

•    Führen Sie eine fortlaufende, umfassende Überprüfung des Projektkostenplans durch, um sicherzustellen, dass die angestrebten Deckungsbeiträge/Margen erreicht werden.
•    Beratung und Mentoring des QS-Teams, insbesondere von Absolventen oder Stipendiaten.
•    Trends im Projekt identifizieren, analysieren und darüber berichten
•    Verwaltung und Prognose des Cashflows Ihres Pakets

•    3-5 Jahre Erfahrung in einer QS-Funktion

- Work closely with Global Pricing & Access Strategy teams to support Pricing & Access optimization by developing analysis, contributing to pricing research, and ensuring P&R guidance is implemented consistently across the IBU.

- Equip, guide and train local teams/partners with processes, standards, tools, and decision frameworks to build high-quality LOCs access excellence in execution.
-Lead and be a role model to digital capability adoption throughout the access community
- Develop and run mock negotiations within the specific TA and orchestrate capability training, and simulation exercises for markets.
- Foster collaboration and best practice sharing across GPA teams, access and cross-functions and geographies partners.

- Resilience with ambiguity and cross-cultural collaboration across international markets/partners.

Erster Teamlead am neuen EveryWare\-Standort Bern: Team aufbauen, technisch aktiv bleiben, Richtung geben.

Teamlead Microsoft IT Services \- Aufbau Standort Bern
======================================================

Wer braucht deine Verstärkung?
-------------------------------

Deine neue Herausforderung ist bei EveryWare, dem führenden Schweizer Cloud\- und IT\-Service\-Provider mit einer eigenen hochskalierbaren DataCenter\- und Netzwerk\-Infrastruktur in Zürich \- und mit Spezialisierung auf die Bedürfnisse von Businesskunden. Rund 250 Mitarbeitende, davon 90% spezialisierte Engineers, bringen internationale Innovationen praktikabel in Schweizer Unternehmen. Über 200 erfolgreich realisierte Grossprojekte für Businesskunden, darunter auch Kunden aus der Banken\- und Versicherungsbranche, belegen die Kompetenz von EveryWare.



So schaffst du Mehrwert
-----------------------

Bern ist kein Satellitenbüro \- es ist ein vollwertiges Team im Aufbau. Du bist die erste Führungsperson vor Ort, baust dein Team schrittweise auf (2026: 3\-4 Engineers, 2027: 5\-6\) und bist gleichzeitig selbst technisch aktiv. Kein Wasserkopf, keine reine Managementstelle.

Was dich konkret erwartet:

* Du baust das Team schrittweise auf und führst es disziplinarisch und fachlich: 1:1\-Gespräche, Kapazitätsplanung, Entwicklung der Teammitglieder.
* Du arbeitest eng mit den fünf weiteren Teamleads und dem Head Microsoft IT Services zusammen.
* Du betreibst und entwickelst Windows\-Server\-, M365\- und Cloud\-Umgebungen für Kunden aktiv mit.
* Du übernimmst technische Projektleitung bei Migrationen, IT\-Outsourcing und Infrastruktur\-Upgrades.
* Du löst komplexe Probleme im 3rd\-Level\-Support und hältst Architekturbeschreibungen und Runbooks aktuell.
* Du stellst Servicequalität und SLA\-Einhaltung gegenüber Kunden sicher und eskalierst, wenn nötig.


Das zeichnet dich aus
---------------------

Du bist keine Führungskraft, die sich vom Tagesgeschäft abgekoppelt hat. Du weisst noch, wie ein Runbook aussieht und du kannst PowerShell lesen und schreiben. Gleichzeitig weisst du, wie man ein Team aufbaut, ohne es zu mikromanagen.

Was du mitbringst:

* 2\-3 Jahre Erfahrung in einer Teamlead\- oder Senior\- mit Personalverantwortung.
* Mehrjährige Praxiserfahrung mit Microsoft\-Umgebungen \- du kennst diese Umgebungen aus dem Betrieb, nicht nur aus der Theorie.
* Fundierte IT\-Infrastruktur\-Kenntnisse: du hast hybride Infrastrukturen aktiv mitgestaltet.
* Strukturierte Kommunikation auf allen Ebenen: Team, Kunden, Management \- auf Deutsch und Englisch, ösisch ein Plus.

### TOP



Dein neuer Arbeitsplatz befindet sich direkt am Hauptbahnhof Bern (Welle 7\) \- öffentliche Verkehrsmittel und unzählige Lunchmöglichkeiten liegen vor der Tür.

Technische Begeisterung trifft auf umfassende Expertise. Hier profitierst du von einem reichen Erfahrungsschatz und einem hochprofessionellen Netzwerk.

=====================================







At Swissquote, we're all in.  

All in to shake things up. All in to build the bank people actually want to use. All in to make finance less boring — and a lot more powerful.



We're Switzerland's leading digital bank — 1,500\+ people across Europe, the Middle East and , building real financial solutions for over a million clients worldwide. From trading and investing to everyday banking, we cover the full picture. We move fast, but we build things we're genuinely proud of. Have a look behind the scenes by checking on Instagram.



Growing fast creates room. Room to try things, own things, and grow at a pace most places can't offer. Whether you like the spotlight or prefer to just put your head down and do great work, there's space for both here.



We've ditched the dress code — but never the chance to celebrate. Big win or small, we make it count. The kind of place where the atmosphere takes care of itself.



As an equal opportunity employer, we welcome candidates from all backgrounds, experiences and perspectives to join our team and contribute to our shared success.



Feeling it? It's a good start. Apply.



**About the Function**



Business Risk Management (BRM) is Swissquote's first\-line risk function, overseeing client onboarding, periodic reviews, and ongoing controls throughout the client lifecycle. Operating across Gland and Zurich, BRM works closely with Front Office, Compliance, and Legal to ensure regulatory compliance while supporting business objectives through a pragmatic, risk\-based approach.



Data Oversight \& Transformation Lead
=====================================



**Role Overview**



As Data, Oversight \& Transformation Lead, you will drive BRM's data and transformation agenda, building the reporting infrastructure and dashboards that give management a complete, real\-time view of the department's activity, and turning that data into insight that feeds strategic decision\-making. Reporting directly to the Head of Business Risk Management, you will work closely with operational teams to structure and validate the data BRM generates, and with Swissquote's technical teams on strategic projects, including related workflow and automation initiatives.



**Key Responsibilities**



* Organize and structure case management data to provide a complete, real\-time view of volumes, backlogs, workload, and SLA / productivity across the department.
* Build dashboards and reports for management use (e.g., via Tableau or similar tools), turning raw case data into clear, decision\-ready views.
* Translate management's reporting and measurement priorities into practical data structures and dashboards.
* Analyse processes to identify and implement tactical automation opportunities, working with Swissquote's technical teams on relevant enterprise workflow initiatives.
* Act as single point of contact for all dat\-related matters, including provision of audit and regulatory\-driven data extractions and reporting as needed.
  **Qualifications** * Master's degree in a Quantitative field, Computer Science or Data Science
* At least 5 years' experience in a data analytics or reporting role, ideally within financial services or a regulated environment.
* Strong hands\-on proficiency with data visualization and reporting tools (e.g., Tableau, PowerBI or equivalent)
* Strong Excel skills; working knowledge of SQL to query and extract data from case management systems.
* Working knowledge of process mapping and low code / no\-code workflow automation tools
* Ability to translate operational / case data into clear, management\-ready dashboards and reports.
* Understanding and/ or solid appetite to learn more about Risk \& Compliance topics within a Swiss bank
* Familiarity with data privacy regulations (GDPR, etc.)
* Excellent communication skills in English, with French being an asset.

Successful employees need top\-tier IT infrastructure and excellent mobility\-not only at work but also in their private lives. We promote employee wellbeing with a strong focus on mental health. Our offerings range from practical self\-care webinars to leadership training. In addition, we provide discounts on numerous fitness programs and sports activities\-ideal for integrating movement into your workday.



**Pension Fund**  


We offer above\-average benefits to help you build a solid retirement plan.

Quality and integrity are essential at KPMG to build trust and drive change. At Swissquote, we're all in.  

All in to shake things up. All in to build the bank people actually want to use. All in to make finance less boring — and a lot more powerful.



We're Switzerland's leading digital bank — 1,500\+ people across Europe, the Middle East and , building real financial solutions for over a million clients worldwide. From trading and investing to everyday banking, we cover the full picture. We move fast, but we build things we're genuinely proud of. Have a look behind the scenes by checking on Instagram.



Growing fast creates room. Room to try things, own things, and grow at a pace most places can't offer. Whether you like the spotlight or prefer to just put your head down and do great work, there's space for both here.



We've ditched the dress code — but never the chance to celebrate. Big win or small, we make it count. The kind of place where the atmosphere takes care of itself.



As an equal opportunity employer, we welcome candidates from all backgrounds, experiences and perspectives to join our team and contribute to our shared success.



Feeling it? It's a good start. Apply.



Head of Controlling \& Risk \- Director
=======================================



The Head Controlling \& Risk leads the Controlling \& Risk department and oversees a multidisciplinary team of approximately 20 employees organised across specialised risks The role is responsible for ensuring that credit, market, liquidity, operational and related regulatory risks are identified, monitored, challenged and reported across the Group in line with the risk appetite defined by the Board of Directors.



The role also oversees the Group's internal control framework, ensuring that key controls, governance standards and related documentation remain effective, consistent and appropriately monitored.



**Key Responsibilities**



*       **Leadership and department management:** define the department's priorities and operating model; lead, coach and develop managers and teams; ensure effective resource allocation and continuous upskilling.



*       **Risk governance and reporting:** produce and present clear reports for the Risk Committee, Executive Management and the Board of Directors; ensure adequate escalation of material risk developments, incidents, KRIs and remediation actions.



*       **Risk framework ownership:** maintain and continuously improve the Group risk management and internal control frameworks, including policies, methodologies, risk appetite monitoring, risk taxonomy, controls and reporting standards; draft, review and update risk policies, procedures and governance documents; support the development of structured approached to assess risk culture, control effectiveness and internal control maturity



The Head Controlling \& Risk provides strategic direction and effective challenge across the following areas, acting as the senior point of contact for C\&R teams, other internal stakeholders, governance bodies and regulators on Controlling \& Risk matters:



*       **Credit, market and liquidity risks \- own investments:** oversee concentration analysis, limit monitoring, stress testing, RWA, capital \& liquidity planning and related risk indicators.



*       **Credit and market risks \- client activities:** oversee the monitoring of clients active in ETD trading, lending and eFX trading, including trading conditions, margin parameters, daily margin call analysis, stress testing and market watch.



*       **Operational risk management:** oversee the identification, assessment, monitoring and reporting of operational risks, excluding dedicated IT and AML topics where separate specialised functions exist; coordinate the RCSA framework, KRIs, incidents and action management monitoring.



*       **Reconciliation activities:** supervise the reconciliation of cash, securities and cryptocurrencies with external counterparties and custodians, ensuring timely escalation and remediation of discrepancies.



*       **Consolidated supervision:** contribute to Group\-level oversight by ensuring consistent risk standards, reporting and escalation across relevant entities and activities.



*       **Regulatory relations:** liaise with FINMA, SIX and other relevant stakeholders on Controlling \& Risk topics, and oversee alignment with applicable regulatory requirements.



*       **Projects, change and new business initiatives:** contribute to New Business Initiative risk analyses, process improvements, automation initiatives and risk\-related transformation projects, including the development of dashboards, maturity assessments and monitoring frameworks supporting continuous improvement of risk governance and internal controls.

*  **In\-scope products and activities:** mainstream securities, including bonds, equities, structured products and precious metals; exchange\-traded derivatives; cryptocurrencies and digital assets; eFX and interbank FX products, including CFDs on multiple underlyings, spot and forward FX.

  **Qualifications** *      Master's degree in a relevant field; a recognised professional qualification in risk, internal controls, audit or finance (e.g. FRM, PRM, CIA, CRMA, CISA or CFA) is strongly preferred.



*      10\+ years of experience in a leadership position in banking, financial services, risk management or a related field, including substantial leadership experience, ideally within a regulated and international financial institution.



*      Proven experience with responsibility for multiple risk disciplines and/or multidisciplinary teams, including exposure to risk governance, internal control frameworks and organisational or control maturity initiatives.



*      Strong strategic leadership and experience managing multidisciplinary expert teams.



*      Broad expertise in credit, market, liquidity and operational risk within a banking environment.



*      Solid knowledge of Swiss banking regulation, FINMA expectations and Basel standards, ideally within a Category 3 bank.



*      Strong strategic thinking, business acumen and judgement.



*      Pragmatic and solutions\-oriented, with the ability to balance risk, business growth and operational efficiency.



*      Strong communication, presentation and writing skills, including risk reports, policies and Board\-level materials



*      Confident constructive challenger, with high integrity, independence and credibility.



*      Technology\-minded, with a strong interest in digitalisation, data and AI.



*      Additional assets:Understanding of ICT, cyber and data\-security with GRC platforms, RCSA, KRI and incident management risk and stress\-testing science, AI and automation applied to risk monitoring and reporting.

Company Description
At Syngenta Group, we're a global community of 56,000 innovators across 90 countries, united by a 250-year legacy of agricultural excellence. As the world's most local agricultural technology partner, we create tailor-made solutions that transform farming while protecting our planet, driven by our commitment to innovation, ethics, and integrity. Through our inclusive environment and diverse perspectives, we pioneer breakthrough solutions for farmers, society, and future generations. Join our worldwide teams of agricultural pioneers in creating a more resilient and equitable food system for all.

Syngenta has been ranked as a top employer by Science Magazine and it has been awarded with the "Friendly Work Space" label to all its Swiss sites.

Job Description
As Assistant to two Global Leadership Team (GLT) Members, you will provide administrative and strategic support, serving as the primary point of contact for administrative and organizational matters for multiple functions. The role requires balancing competing executive priorities, anticipating business needs, and ensuring seamless coordination across executive offices. Given the global scope and seniority of the supported executives, flexibility in working hours is required to accommodate shifting priorities, time zones, and urgent requests.

Completes a broad variety of advanced administrative tasks including: managing an extremely active calendar of appointments; approving expense reports on behalf of the GLT members; composing and preparing confidential correspondence; arranging complex global travel plans, itineraries, and agendas; and compiling documents for travel-related meetings.
Provides administrative support related to organizing the GLT members’ professional and, where applicable, personal commitments.
Plans, coordinates, and ensures the various schedules are followed and respected. Acts in a "gatekeeper" and "gateway" role, creating win-win situations for direct access to the calendars and offices.
Balances and prioritizes the needs of two GLT members, ensuring effective coordination of calendars, stakeholder requests, meeting preparation, travel, correspondence, and follow-up actions while maintaining discretion, sound judgment, and full awareness of business priorities.
Coordinates multiple internal and external meetings with various stakeholders.
Researches, prioritizes, and follows up on incoming issues and concerns addressed, including those of a sensitive or confidential nature. Determines the appropriate course of action, referral, or response.
Works as part of a broader executive assistant team, collaborating closely with peers, sharing information proactively, and deputizing where required to ensure seamless, continuous, and high-quality support across the executive office.
Identifies opportunities to improve administrative processes, digital ways of working, tracking systems, and coordination routines to increase effectiveness across the executive office.

Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional education.
Minimum of 5–8 years of experience supporting Executive Leadership Team members in a complex, global multinational company.
Demonstrated ability to proactively manage complex, sensitive issues and to work independently on projects.
Proven ability to perform at a high level under pressure, adapting quickly to competing demands while maintaining outstanding quality of output and a realistic balance among multiple priorities.
Very strong interpersonal skills and the ability to build trust-based relationships with stakeholders at all levels, including senior executives and external partners.
Outstanding judgment, discretion, and diplomatic skills in handling confidential information.
Business-fluent written and verbal communication skills in English (additional languages are a plus), with strong organizational skills and meticulous attention to detail.
Proactive, solution-oriented approach to problem-solving with strong decision-making capabilities.
High flexibility to accommodate a demanding and fluid schedule.
High proficiency in modern digital workplace tools, enterprise productivity suites (such as Microsoft Office, Teams, and SharePoint), collaboration platforms, and various AI productivity tools.
Understanding of the agricultural business and global industry drivers is highly preferred.
Additional Information
What We Offer

A variety of financial and non-financial benefits including:

A position which contributes to valuable and impactful work in a stimulating and international environment
A superb working environment with an open culture and diverse workforce where new ideas are always welcome
The opportunity to work with and learn from highly qualified and experienced employees and gain scientific and technical excellence
A Learning culture (Together we Grow) and wide range of training options
You will benefit from a competitive pension fund plan, flexible working arrangements, an attractive bonus system, an onsite doctor, a fitness room, a canteen, and other benefits such as family-friendly initiatives and child and family allowances

DevOps Engineer (a) (80 – 100%)
=================================




**HRM Systems AG mit Sitz in Winterthur ist ein erfolgreiches Familienunternehmen mit 160 Mitarbeitenden und langer Firmengeschichte. Grossunternehmen und Unternehmensgruppen werden bei der Abwicklung von HR\-Prozessen und im betrieblichen Gesundheitsmanagement durch die im Hause entwickelten Softwarelösungen und Dienstleistungen unterstützt. Als Marktleader in ihrem Bereich steht das Unternehmen auf stabilen und finanziell gesunden Beinen. Dies ermöglicht die gezielte Investition in die wegweisende Weiterentwicklung ihrer Produkte. Auf dich warten flexible Arbeitszeitmodelle, grosszügige Home\-Office\-Regelungen, sehr gute Sozialleistungen sowie moderne Arbeitsbedingungen. Mit der spürbar gelebten Wertekultur «Gemeinsam», «Mutig», «Begeistert» und «Respektvoll» bietet man dir ein attraktives Umfeld.**

**Die IT von HRM Systems entwickelt sich stetig weiter. Komplexe Produkte, gewachsene Infrastrukturen und moderne SaaS\-Architekturen bringen spannende technische Herausforderungen mit sich. Um den Bereich DevOps über alle Produkte hinweg gezielt zu stärken, wird ein neues, kleines DevOps\-Team aufgebaut. Dieses Team bildet künftig die Brücke zwischen dem Produktbereich, interner Infrastruktur, Betriebsinfrastruktur und dem Entwicklungsbereich. Damit entsteht eine vielseitige mit Gestaltungsspielraum und technischer Verantwortung. Im Rahmen eines Exklusivmandats suchen wir eine:n erfahrene:n DevOps Engineer.**




**Deine Herausforderung**

* Du unterstützt übergreifend die Produktentwicklungsteams rund um die drei Produkte UKA Solutions, CAREMA und UKA Connect bei DevOps\-Themen und betreust die bestehende Infrastruktur.

* Du stellst den stabilen Betrieb von Produktions\- und Entwicklungsumgebungen auf Infrastruktur\-Ebene sicher.

* Du analysierst und behebst Störungen in enger Zusammenarbeit mit den Entwicklungsteams, IT\-Services und dem externen Infrastruktur\-Provider.

* Du optimierst die Automatisierung rund um Builds, Deployments, Testing, Monitoring und Alerting.

* Du bringst technische Konzepte voran und schaffst die Grundlage für eine stabile, sichere und wartungsarme Infrastruktur.

* Du arbeitest mit Technologien und Werkzeugen wie GitLab, OpenShift, Docker, Kubernetes, PostgreSQL, ELK, Grafana und Nagios.

* Du übernimmst übergreifende Themen wie die Verwaltung von Lizenzen und Zugriffsberechtigungen für Entwickler.

* Du entwickelst ein neu entstehendes DevOps Team aktiv mit und bringst deine Ideen für langfristig tragfähige Lösungen ein.




**Deine Qualitäten und Begabungen**

* Mindestens 3 Jahre Berufserfahrung im DevOps oder DevOps\-nahen Umfeld

* Abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder entsprechende Berufserfahrung (du kommst entweder aus der Softwareentwicklung und hast dich in Richtung DevOps entwickelt oder du bringst einen Infrastruktur\-Background mit starkem DevOps\-Engineering Verständnis mit)

* Von Vorteil sind Kenntnisse von mehreren Technologien, welche sich mit denen bei HRM decken: OpenShift, Kubernetes, Docker, PostgreSQL, CI/CD, GitLab

* Du gestaltest gerne mit und bringst deine Ideen ein

* Du fühlst dich in einem Umfeld wohl, in dem noch nicht alles abschliessend definiert ist, und gehst Themen proaktiv, analytisch und lösungsorientiert an.

* In Deutsch bist du verhandlungssicher

Chief of Staff (a) (80\-100%)
=============================




**Technology \& Leadership – dafür steht Consult \& Pepper. Als spezialisierte Personalberatung besetzen wir seit über 25 Jahren anspruchsvolle Fach\- und Führungspositionen. Dabei arbeiten wir branchenagnostisch mit Start\-Ups, KMUs und internationalen Grosskonzernen zusammen.**

**Unsere Unternehmenskultur ist geprägt von einem familiären Miteinander, offener und manchmal etwas sehr direkter Kommunikation sowie einem starken Teamgeist. Kollegiale Unterstützung, kurze Entscheidungswege und gemeinsame Events sorgen dafür, dass Arbeit bei uns nicht nur erfolgreich, sondern auch menschlich ist.**

**Zur Unterstützung unserer beiden Co\-CEOs suchen wir ein neugieriges, lernfähiges und umsetzungsstarkes Organisationstalent mit hoher Technologieaffinität als « Chief of Staff».**




**Deine Herausforderung**

Du stehst kurz vor deinem Studienabschluss oder hast diesen gerade hinter dir – und suchst keinen klassischen Einstiegsjob? Du möchtest nicht in einem Traineeprogramm eine Station von vielen durchlaufen, sondern direkt erleben, wie ein Unternehmen geführt wird?  
In dieser vielseitigen Stabsrolle erhältst du Einblick in nahezu alle Bereiche eines KMUs, unterstützt die Geschäftsleitung im operativen Tagesgeschäft und übernimmst zunehmend eigene Projekte und Verantwortungsbereiche.

Deine Aufgabenschwerpunkte sehen wie folgt aus – wobei sich deine im Laufe der Zeit verändern und weiterentwickeln wird.

* **Management Support \& Business Operations (\~40%)**
    + Du unterstützt unsere beiden Co\-CEOs im operativen Tagesgeschäft und hältst ihnen bei administrativen und organisatorischen Aufgaben den Rücken frei
    + Du bereitest Präsentationen, Auswertungen, Controllings und Entscheidungsgrundlagen auf
    + Du koordinierst zentrale interne Abläufe und entwickelst bestehende Instrumente und Prozesse weiter
    + Du bist Anlaufstelle für unsere Mitarbeitenden bei organisatorischen und administrativen Fragestellungen
* **Provider Management \& Infrastruktur (\~15%)**
    + Du koordinierst schrittweise unsere externen Partner und Dienstleister, insbesondere in den Bereichen IT, LinkedIn und Jobplattformen
    + Du verwaltest zentrale Firmenaccounts, Lizenzen und Verträge und behältst Kosten, Laufzeiten und Leistungen im Blick
    + Du stellst gemeinsam mit unseren Partnern sicher, dass unsere Mitarbeitenden über eine funktionierende und zeitgemässe Arbeitsumgebung verfügen
* **Marketing \& Kommunikation (\~20%)**
    + Du gestaltest unseren Unternehmensauftritt auf LinkedIn sowie weitere zentrale Kommunikationskanäle mit
    + Du verantwortest unser Newslettering und unterstützt bei der Weiterentwicklung unserer Website
    + Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit dem Team Marketing\- und Kundenaktivitäten
* **Digitalisierung, AI \& Projekte (\~25%)**
    + Du treibst Projekte in den Bereichen AI, Digitalisierung und Business Development voran
    + Du beobachtest technologische Entwicklungen und prüfst, wie neue Tools und AI\-Anwendungen bei C\&P sinnvoll eingesetzt werden können
    + Du unterstützt die Co\-CEOs bei konzeptionellen und strategischen Projekten und bringst diese in die Umsetzung



**Deine Qualitäten und Begabungen**

* Du hast dein Studium in Wirtschaftsinformatik oder BWL (Uni/FH) abgeschlossen oder stehst kurz davor
* Du besitzt relevante Praxiserfahrung, die du während oder nach deinem Studium \- z.B. via Praktika, Teilzeittätigkeit oder im Rahmen einer Festanstellung \- sammeln durftest
* Du hast eine ausgeprägte Affinität für Technologie, Digitalisierung und AI und freust dich daran, neue Tools auszuprobieren. Dabei denkst du realistisch und weisst, dass wir keine Luftschlösser bauen und dass der konkrete Nutzen gegeben sein muss
* Du wendest die Microsoft 365 Tools gut und gerne an \- insbesondere PowerPoint und Excel
* Du magst Zahlen, bist zuverlässig und gehst die Dinge strukturiert an
* Du bist ein Organisationstalent oder willst und kannst eines werden. So oder so hast du eine schnelle Auffassungsgabe und die Fähigkeit, dich rasch in neue Themen einzuarbeiten.
* Du willst, dass deine Marketingaktivitäten Wirkung im Ziel haben. Das Look \& Feel ist dir dabei aber nicht egal.
* Du bist keine Diva und dir nicht zu schade, dir auch mal die schmutzig zu machen und in einem KMU Aufgaben zu erledigen, die eigentlich nicht in deinem Stellenbeschrieb stehen
* Du sprichst fliessend Deutsch und hast gute Englischkenntnisse
* Du bist so humorvoll, dass du zuweilen auch mal über dich selber lachen kannst



**Wir suchen kein fertiges Profil. Wir suchen jemanden am Anfang seiner oder ihrer Karriere, dem wir zutrauen, sehr schnell zu lernen und Verantwortung zu übernehmen. Dabei arbeitest du direkt mit den beiden Eigentümern und Co\-CEOs von Consult \& Pepper zusammen und erlebst aus nächster Nähe, wie ein KMU geführt und weiterentwickelt wird.**

METTLER TOLEDO is a global leader in precision instruments and services. We are renowned for innovation and quality across laboratory, process analytics, industrial, product inspection, and retailing applications. Our sales and service network is one of the most extensive in the industry. Our products are sold in more than 140 countries, and we have a direct presence in approximately 40 countries. For more information, please visit  

**Our Opening and Your Responsibilities**  


The Software Development Center (SWDC) is METTLER TOLEDO's internal software service center supporting multiple business units with software\-based solutions.

SWDC develops secure, modern software solutions for on\-premises, cloud, and mobile environments. Our multidisciplinary teams combine software engineering, system integration, robotics, automation, and technical consulting to drive innovation and digital transformation across our global organization.

For our global headquarters in Nänikon\-Greifensee, we are looking for a Software Engineer Integration \& Automation 100% (all genders) to join our Software Development Center and support the development of innovative software solutions connecting laboratory instruments, automation systems, robotics platforms, and enterprise applications.

In this role, you will work closely with software development teams, requirement engineers, business stakeholders, and integration partners to design, develop, and maintain reliable integration and automation solutions with real\-world impact.

Your responsibilities include:

* Develop, maintain, and enhance laboratory software solutions around system integration, automation, and connectivity such as our LabX API based products.
* Design, maintain, and improve laboratory automation and robotics solutions, including applications based on platforms such as ABB RobotStudio with RAPID programming.
* Ownership of our robotic cells used for demonstration and exploration of new use cases and technical feasibility studies.
* Collaborate with development teams on a global scale, business stakeholders, integration partners, and vendors to deliver scalable and secure solutions.
* Provide technical consulting and engineering support for internal and external stakeholders.
* Ensure high software quality through testing, documentation, deployment, and the application of secure software development practices.
* Support the development of advanced robotics environments, AI\-enabled laboratory automation solutions, simulation environments, and customer demonstration setups across Europe.
**What You Need to Succeed**  


Following requirements are necessary for this role:

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, Automation Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* Several years of professional experience in software development, ideally in software engineering and system integration environments.
* Strong object\-oriented programming skills, ideally in .NET/C\#, but also Web\-based programming and Python.
* Solid understanding of software engineering best practices, including source control, code reviews, coding standards, automated testing, and CI/CD processes.
* Familiarity with REST/SOAP APIs, OPC UA, XML/JSON, cloud technologies, Docker, Kubernetes, Windows\-based services and authentication technologies.
* Ideally experience with robotics application platforms such as ABB RobotStudio, RAPID programming, ABB OmniCore systems.
* Interest in applying modern software engineering practices, AI\-assisted development tools, MCP and agent\-based workflows.
* Team player, initiative, good analytical thinking and good communication skills, ready for one or the other short travelling trip within Europe.
* Fluent in English (oral and written); German language skills are a plus.
**Our Offer to You**  


We offer:

* Flexible working hours (depending on the role), a hybrid work model, and a wide portfolio of training opportunities
* A 40\-hour work week with at least 25 vacation days per year, plus 4 to 7 additional days off between bank holidays
* Free parking and direct access to public transport
* Healthy lunches cooked onsite at our own METTLER TOLEDO restaurant, with special prices for employees
* A range of additional attractive benefits, including employee discounts at select area businesses


You can expect challenging, interesting, and varied tasks in an innovative and international environment, with the opportunity to network globally and achieve your career goals.  

Have we raised your interest? Then we look forward to receiving your complete application at our Job portal.

Company Description
-------------------





Welcome to SMG Swiss Marketplace Group!  
SMG is a pioneering network of online marketplaces and a leading European digital company that simplifies people’s lives with forward\-looking products.  
We operate leading marketplaces across real estate, automotive, general classifieds, and finance \& insurance. We’re driven by our values: Better Together, Aim High, and Act Responsibly.









Description
-----------





Your Mission



As a Senior SEO Manager you are responsible for driving organic growth from Search Engines and AI Search Interfaces within multiple SMG business units (e.g. Real Estate, Automotive, General Marketplaces or Finance). You won’t just optimize pages — you will help shape product features, scalable landing page systems and platform capabilities that generate long\-term organic growth across platforms our users search. You act as the bridge between Product, Engineering, Marketing and Data, ensuring SEO becomes an integrated part of how we build products.  
Your goal: turn user demand into scalable platform growth.  




What you will  

Growth \& Strategy



* Own and execute Roadmap initiatives
* Translate search demand into product initiatives and growth opportunities
* Plan initiatives based on hypotheses, impact estimation and ROI potential
* Identify scalable growth levers (indexation, internal linking, landing page generation, content systems)
* Understand user behaviour across different search \& discovery platforms and adapt your strategy accordingly


Product\-Led SEO



* Work closely with Product Managers to integrate SEO into product development
* Define SEO requirements for new features and platform capabilities that are scalable .across SMG’s portfolio
* Build frameworks that enable growth beyond manual optimizations
* Help teams understand why SEO matters, not just what to implement


Stakeholder Collaboration



* Act as a trusted advisor for Product, Engineering and Marketing
* Communicate clearly with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders
* Drive alignment and ownership across teams


Data \& Experimentation



* Build hypotheses and validate them with data
* Monitor performance and iterate based on learnings
* Measure success via business impact, not vanity metrics
* Work with analysts and engineers to improve tracking and reporting








Qualifications
--------------





What will you bring to the ride?



* 5\+ years of SEO experience on large websites (marketplaces, classifieds, real estate or platforms)
* Experience working with Product teams and agile environments
* Strong stakeholder communication skills
* Data\-driven mindset with the ability to turn insights into actions
* Ability to plan initiatives and support them with business impact estimates
* Hands\-on knowledge of technical SEO (crawling, indexing, rendering)
* A proactive, ownership\-driven “go\-getter” attitude
* Growth mindset and curiosity for experimentation
* Fluency in English


Bonus



* Experience in Product\-Led SEO
* Experience with large\-scale landing page systems
* Marketplace or classifieds background
* Experiments with AI Search/GEO








Additional Information
----------------------





What success looks like



* SEO becomes a natural part of product development
* Teams proactively involve SEO early in planning
* New scalable growth systems are launched
* Organic traffic growth correlates with business KPIs
* Clear hypotheses ? experiments ? learnings ? impact






What we offer?



* 6 weeks of holidays per year (plus option to buy 10 extra days)
* 40\-hour work week with flexitime (capped at 45 hours)
* A hybrid work setup with flexibility to work remotely
* Generous parental leave: 18 weeks for maternity and 6 weeks for paternity/adoption
* SBB Half\-Fare Card and first\-class travel between SMG offices in Switzerland
* An inclusive and innovative environment where your voice matters






Why this role is different



You will help build systems that scale growth across some of Switzerland’s largest platforms — and shape how SEO works in an AI\-first search world.







Interested?



We’d love to hear from you. send us your CV and a few lines about why you’re excited to join.
